About Us



We run creator armies for apps, from bootstrapped founders to post-IPO companies. We recruit and manage hundreds of UGC creators across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube on behalf of our clients, get them warmed up, and get them posting branded content that drives real growth. We're a small, fast-moving team and we're rebuilding our operations function right now, so this is a chance to help shape how things run rather than just fitting into an existing machine.



The Role



We need a second operations person to work alongside our current VA and take real ownership of the creator side of the business: making sure creators actually post, staying on top of account warm-up, keeping our trackers accurate, and being the fast, reliable point of contact creators go to instead of getting lost in 
 DMs.



This is not a creative or strategy role. We need someone who is organized, chronically online, comfortable chasing people persistently but politely, and who treats a spreadsheet or tracker like it's sacred. If "who hasn't posted yet, who's still warming up, and why" is a question you'd naturally want to answer before anyone asks it, this is your job.



What You'll Own



Creator communication and follow-up: DM and follow up with creators on 
 and other channels to make sure they've set up accounts, are warming up on schedule, and are posting on time. Chase people down without being annoying about it.



Account health and warm-up tracking: Track every creator's account status (day of warm-up, when they're cleared for branded content, any account health flags) and keep our tracker current and accurate, not just "roughly right."



Campaign staffing visibility: Keep an up-to-date view of how many creators are active vs. needed per campaign, flag understaffed campaigns early, and help source and onboard replacements.



Creator support: Be the first line of response for common creator questions (payment issues, shadowbans, which username to use, how CPM works, etc.), using an FAQ/SOP we're building out, and escalate anything unusual.



CRM and creator ranking upkeep: Help maintain our internal creator database, ratings, and notes so we always know who our best, most reliable creators are.




 management: Post new brand deal opportunities, keep channels organized, review applicants against basic criteria, and generally keep the community easy to navigate for creators.



Reporting: Send a short, honest daily or end-of-day update on active creators, posting status, and any blockers, no vague "everything's on track" updates. We want real numbers.



What We Don't Need You To Do



Write creative briefs or content strategy (that stays in-house with leadership)

Manage client relationships or client calls

Make payment approvals or have financial admin access



You Might Be a Fit If



You've done creator/influencer management, community management, or UGC campaign coordination before (agency-side experience is a big plus)



You're comfortable in 
, Sideshift/LaunchPoint-style creator platforms, Slack, and

You can work independently, flag problems early, and don't sit on bad news hoping it resolves itself



Nice to Have

Experience with CPM-based or performance-based creator deals

Basic comfort using AI tools (ChatGPT/Claude) to speed up repetitive work like drafting FAQ answers or summarizing creator threads

Role Overview



I am looking for a dependable Social Media Content Manager and Video Editor who can manage the post-production and distribution side of the Next Haven Life content system.



You should be comfortable taking raw talking-head footage, editing it into engaging YouTube videos, extracting strong short-form clips, creating thumbnails and graphics, writing platform-specific captions, and scheduling approved content.



This is not just a basic video-cutting position. I need someone who understands pacing, audience retention, storytelling, content repurposing, and maintaining a consistent brand across platforms.



You will not be expected to provide immigration, legal, tax, real estate, or financial advice. Scripts and factual claims will either be provided or approved before publication.



Primary Responsibilities

Video Editing



-Edit long-form talking-head YouTube videos.

-Remove pauses, mistakes, repetitions, and unnecessary sections.

-Improve pacing without making the speaker sound unnatural.

-Add tasteful zooms, transitions, lower thirds, captions, screenshots, maps, charts, B-roll, and supporting visuals.

-Clean and balance audio.

-Apply basic color correction.

-Add branded introductions, outros, disclaimers, and calls to action.

-Export videos in the correct format for each platform.



Short-Form Content



-Identify the strongest 
nts from each long-form video.

-Create YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and
 Reels.

-Add accurate burned-in captions.

-Write strong opening hooks.

-Reframe footage appropriately for vertical viewing.

-Keep short-form edits direct, clear, and professional rather than overly flashy.



YouTube Management



-Create compelling but honest titles.

-Write video descriptions and chapters.

-Create or coordinate thumbnails.

-Upload and schedule approved videos.

-Add cards, end screens, playlists, links, disclaimers, and calls to action.

-Monitor basic performance data such as click-through rate, audience retention, watch time, and subscriber growth.

-Recommend improvements based on actual performance.

-Social Media Management



Repurpose approved content for:



-YouTube

-Instagram



-LinkedIn



Responsibilities include:



-Writing platform-specific captions.

-Scheduling posts.

-Creating carousels, quote graphics, and supporting visuals.

-Maintaining a consistent content calendar.

-Responding to routine comments using approved guidance.

-Escalating questions involving legal, tax, immigration, property, healthcare, or individualized relocation advice.

-Keeping content files and publishing records organized.

-Expected Monthly Output



The initial target will be approximately:



-2–4 edited long-form YouTube videos

-8–16 short-form videos

-2 thumbnail options for each long-form video

-Platform-specific captions and descriptions

-YouTube chapters, cards, end screens, and links

-Supporting graphics or carousels when appropriate

-Content scheduling across approved platforms

-One simple monthly analytics report

-An organized archive of raw footage, project files, thumbnails, captions, and final exports



The workload may grow as the brand develops.



Brand Style

Next Haven Life should feel:



Credible

-Strategic

-Calm

-Direct

-Experienced

-Family-conscious

-Caribbean-informed

-Professional without feeling corporate

-Realistic rather than promotional



The content may include a warm Caribbean influence, but it should never feel like a tourism commercial.



Avoid excessive sound effects, distracting transitions, 
-style edits, exaggerated thumbnails, misleading titles, and clickbait that weakens trust.



The ideal visual style is clean, polished, authoritative, warm, and modern.



Required Skills

You should have demonstrated experience with:



-Talking-head YouTube editing

-Short-form vertical video editing

-Audio cleanup and synchronization

-Captions and motion graphics

-YouTube thumbnails

-Social media scheduling

-Content repurposing

-Canva

-YouTube Studio

-File and project organization

-Strong written English

-Following a defined brand voice

-Meeting deadlines without constant supervision



You may use Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or another professional editing platform, provided you can deliver consistent, high-quality work.



Strongly Preferred

Experience with any of the following is helpful:



-YouTube audience-retention editing

-Educational or professional content

-Personal brands

-Caribbean, expatriate, financial, veteran, retirement, travel, or relocation topics

-LinkedIn content

-Canva brand kits

-Microsoft 365 or OneDrive

-Airtable

-AI-assisted editing and content repurposing

-Basic analytics and A/B thumbnail testing



Responsible use of AI is welcome, but all captions, titles, summaries, and factual statements must be reviewed before submission.



Work Arrangement

This is a remote position.



Most work can be completed asynchronously. However, you should be available for a short weekly planning or review call and have at least limited overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.



Clear communication is essential. I value people who raise questions early, provide honest progress updates, and do not disappear when a deadline approaches.



Paid Trial Project

Selected applicants will be offered a paid trial assignment using one talking-head video.



The trial may include:



-Editing one long-form video segment

-Creating two or three short-form clips

-Producing one YouTube thumbnail

-Drafting a title, description, and social caption

-Organizing and submitting the source and final files correctly



The trial will be used to evaluate editing quality, judgment, reliability, communication, and ability to follow the Next Haven Life style.



Do not complete unpaid sample work before being selected for the paid trial.



How to Apply

Please include the following:



1. A brief introduction explaining why this role fits your experience.

2. Links to two or three talking-head videos you personally edited.

3. Links to at least two short-form videos you created.

4. One example of a YouTube thumbnail you designed.

5. The editing software you use.

6. Your current availability and preferred work schedule.

7. Your requested monthly salary for 15–20 hours per week.

8. A description of your process for turning one long-form video into multiple social posts.

9. A short explanation of how you use AI in your editing or content workflow.

10. Confirmation that you are willing to complete a paid trial project.



Begin your application subject line with:



NEXT HAVEN EDITOR — [Your Name]



Applications that do not use this subject line will not be considered.



Please do not send a generic application. I am looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship and helping develop a credible Caribbean relocation media brand.

title: SEO + GEO / AI Search Visibility Specialist
description:
SEO + GEO / AI Search Visibility Specialist



Google • ChatGPT • Claude • Perplexity



We are looking for an experienced SEO and GEO/AEO specialist to solve a very specific visibility problem for Revela Retreats, based in Costa Rica.



Our target market is the USA



Although our retreat centre is in Costa Rica, our primary target market is the United States.



We want Americans researching subjects related to iboga, ibogaine, addiction recovery, PTSD, mental health, detox, integration, psychedelic-assisted therapy and professional education to be able to discover us.



Our problem



Competitors in Costa Rica and Mexico are appearing prominently when Americans search online for terms such as:



- Ibogaine Costa Rica

- Iboga Costa Rica

- Iboga retreat Costa Rica

- Ibogaine retreat

- Ibogaine treatment

- Ibogaine and addiction

- Ibogaine and opioid addiction

- Ibogaine and PTSD

- Psychedelic-assisted therapy

- Psychedelic education for mental health professionals



These competitors are openly using these keywords and being found.



We are not visible enough and, as a result, we are not attracting the clients we should be attracting.



We need someone who can determine WHY our competitors are being found and Revela is not — and then help us fix it.



Our objective



We want Revela to become discoverable to our US target audience through:



Google • ChatGPT • Claude • Perplexity • other AI/search platforms



We are particularly interested in building authority around Costa Rica + iboga + ibogaine + addiction recovery + PTSD + mental health professional education + retreats and integration.



Skills we are looking for



You should have genuine experience with:



- Technical SEO

- US-focused SEO and keyword research

- Google Search Console

- Competitor and keyword-gap analysis

- Search intent

- On-page SEO

- Content strategy and topic clusters

- Internal linking

- Backlink building and digital PR

- Schema / structured data

- Entity SEO

- Local and international SEO

- GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation)

- AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation)

- AI / LLM search visibility

- Google indexing, crawling, sitemaps and canonical URLs

- Measuring rankings, impressions, conversions and organic traffic



This is NOT simply a social-media, VA or blog-writing position.



We need someone who understands how to build search authority and visibility in the US market and who is comfortable working with the terminology and subject matter above.



IMPORTANT — please do this before applying



Search Google as though you were an American looking for these services:



“ibogaine Costa Rica”

“iboga Costa Rica”

“iboga retreat Costa Rica”

“ibogaine treatment Costa Rica”



Look at the businesses that appear.



Then analyse:







Please answer these questions in your application:

3. How would you specifically improve our visibility to people searching from the United States?



4. What experience do you have getting businesses discovered through Google AND AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity?



5. Please provide examples of SEO results you have achieved, preferably with measurable before-and-after results.



We are a growing Costa Rican retreat business looking for someone who can potentially work with us long term.



If you understand this problem, have the skills to solve it, are comfortable working with these keywords and believe you can significantly improve our visibility in the United States, we want to hear from you.

title: Virtual Production Coordinator — Construction / Outdoor Living
description:
EDGE Outdoors is looking for a highly organized Virtual Production Coordinator to support our outdoor-living construction projects from the moment a job is sold through production readiness.



This is not a general administrative assistant position. You will help turn a sold project into an organized, documented, ready-to-build project.



EDGE Outdoors is a South Carolina outdoor-living contractor. We build projects such as screen rooms, sunrooms, pergolas, decks, patios, and other outdoor living spaces.



This is a full-time role as we scale. Target workload is up to 40 hours per week, with compensation in the $5-$8/hour range and a maximum monthly budget of $1,200.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Once a project is sold, you will work with the Project Manager to help prepare the project for production. Your responsibilities may include:



- Meeting with the Project Manager for a Sold Project Handoff / Production Review.

- Reviewing contracts, estimates, plans, selections, photos, notes, and project scope.

- Identifying missing information or decisions that could delay production.

- Creating detailed work orders for crews and subcontractors.

- Preparing material takeoffs and material order forms from approved project information.

- Organizing project documents and production folders.

- Preparing and submitting permit applications as authorized.

- Tracking permit approvals, inspection requirements, and required documentation.

- Researching local permit and licensing requirements for applicable municipalities.

- Preparing purchase orders and vendor documentation as directed.

- Confirming customer selections and specifications are properly documented.

- Assisting with subcontractor scopes and production documentation.

- Tracking long-lead materials and required delivery dates.

- Maintaining accurate project status in EDGE systems and following up on missing information.

- Helping confirm that every project is Production Ready before scheduling.



THE STANDARD



When production receives a project, the team should not have to hunt for information. The project file should clearly answer:



- What are we building?

- What materials are required?

- What has been ordered?

- Who is performing each portion of the work?

- What permits or approvals are required?

- What customer selections have been made?

- What is still outstanding?

- Is the project actually ready to schedule?



YOU MAY BE A STRONG FIT IF YOU ARE



- Extremely organized and detail-oriented.

- Comfortable following structured processes and checklists.

- Able to read construction estimates, scopes, plans, and specifications.

- Comfortable communicating professionally with contractors, suppliers, and government offices.

- Good at finding missing information before it becomes a problem.

- Persistent with follow-up and comfortable managing multiple projects at once.

- Able to work independently without constant supervision.

- Strong with spreadsheets, PDFs, online forms, and project-management software.

- Clear and professional in written English.



CONSTRUCTION EXPERIENCE STRONGLY PREFERRED



Relevant backgrounds include residential construction, remodeling, decks/outdoor living, landscaping or hardscapes, roofing/exteriors, estimating, purchasing, material ordering, permitting, project coordination, or construction administration.



Experience with JobTread or similar construction-management software is a plus. You should also be comfortable with Google Workspace, PDFs, construction drawings, supplier/vendor portals, and municipal permitting websites.



IMPORTANT ROLE BOUNDARY



The Project Manager owns field execution and project decisions. The Virtual Production Coordinator owns the administrative readiness of the project: documentation, procurement support, permits, follow-up, and completeness.



You will not be responsible for unsupervised engineering, code interpretation, contractor licensing, or field construction decisions.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



- Sold projects move into production without administrative confusion.

- Work orders accurately reflect the sold scope.

- Material orders are prepared correctly and on time.

- Permit requirements are identified early and tracked.

- Missing information is caught before field production.

- Project Managers spend less time on paperwork and more time managing projects.

- Every project has a clear, organized production file before work begins.



TO APPLY



Please include the word READY in the first line of your application.



Then answer the following:



1. Briefly introduce yourself and your relevant experience.

2. What construction, remodeling, project coordination, purchasing, estimating, or permitting experience do you have?

3. What software systems have you used? Include construction-management tools, spreadsheets, PDFs, vendor portals, permitting websites, or project-management software.

4. Have you prepared work orders, material orders, purchase orders, permit applications, or project handoff documents before? If yes, describe what you did.

5. Explain how you would organize the handoff of a newly sold construction project from Sales to Production. A strong answer should address scope review, missing information, work orders, materials, permits, procurement, and a production-ready check.

6. What is your availability, preferred working hours, and earliest start date?

7. What is your expected hourly rate?



Applications that do not answer the screening question may not be reviewed.

title: YouTube Video Editor – Long-Form + Motion Graphics
description:
I'm looking for a creative video editor to work with me on an ongoing basis editing long-form YouTube videos for my channel.



The videos are mainly tutorial / talking-head style, usually combining talking-head footage with screen recordings, B-roll, text, graphics, motion graphics, sound effects and other visual elements to keep the video engaging.



I'm not looking for a beginner. You should already be comfortable editing YouTube videos and be able to show examples of your previous work.



I have a specific editing style I'm developing for the channel, and I'm happy to provide examples, feedback and direction. I'm looking for someone who has a good foundation, good visual instincts and, importantly, is able to learn and improve quickly.



However, your knowledge and use of your preferred video editing tool must be advanced.



The goal is to develop a long-term working relationship where you become familiar with the channel, the editing style and what I'm looking for, rather than working with a different editor for every video.



THE EDITING



The raw material will mainly consist of:



* Talking-head footage

* Screen recordings / tutorials

* B-roll

* Graphics and images



The finished videos should feel polished, modern and visually interesting, as well as maintain rythm and engagement.



I'm looking for someone who understands how to make talking-head content more engaging through things such as:



* Good pacing and cuts

* Motion graphics

* Animated text and typography

* Zooms and visual emphasis

* Screen-recording animations

* Sound effects and sound design

* Creative transitions where appropriate

* Other visual ideas that help explain what is being discussed



I don't want excessive effects added just for the sake of it. The editing should support the content and help maintain viewer attention.



WORKLOAD



I expect approximately 2 long-form videos per month, although the amount of work may vary from month to month.



A typical video may involve approximately four or five days of editing, depending on its length and complexity.



This is therefore better suited to someone interested in an ongoing flexible collaboration rather than a fixed number of hours every week.



PAYMENT



I would prefer to pay per finished minute of edited video rather than per hour.



For example, if the final edited video is 20 minutes long, payment would be based on 20 finished minutes.



The exact rate can be agreed depending on your experience, portfolio and the level of editing required.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



You should:



* Already have experience editing YouTube or similar online video content

* Be able to show examples of your previous editing work

* Have good visual and creative instincts

* Have some experience with motion graphics

* Be comfortable receiving detailed feedback

* Be able to reproduce a style from reference videos

* Be willing to learn and improve over time

* Communicate reliably

* Be interested in developing a long-term working relationship



I'm more interested in finding someone with good fundamentals, creativity and the ability to learn than someone with an impressive job title.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send me:



1. 2–3 examples of your best relevant editing work, preferably long-form YouTube, tutorial or talking-head videos.

2. Which editing software you use.

3. Your experience with motion graphics.

4. Your preferred rate per finished minute of edited video.

5. Your general availability.



Please don't send dozens of portfolio links. I'd rather see a few examples that genuinely represent the quality of work you can produce.



For shortlisted applicants, I may also offer a small paid test edit before beginning regular work.

About Starbond

This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, proactive, highly organized, and comfortable working with suppliers across multiple countries and cultures.







Position Summary

The Procurement Specialist is responsible for sourcing and managing suppliers across the United States and Asia, negotiating pricing and commercial terms, evaluating supplier capabilities, and ensuring a reliable and cost-effective supply of materials.



This role plays a critical part in protecting supply continuity, reducing procurement costs, supporting contract manufacturing initiatives, and ensuring Starbond maintains a diversified supplier network that supports long-term business growth.



Key Responsibilities



Strategic Sourcing

Source, evaluate, and qualify suppliers across the United States and Asia.

Conduct supplier research, RFQs, quotation comparisons, and supplier evaluations.

Develop and maintain qualified primary and backup suppliers for critical materials.

Identify new sourcing opportunities that improve cost, quality, and supply continuity.

Support contract manufacturer and third-party logistics (3PL) sourcing initiatives.

Verify supplier capabilities, certifications, and compliance requirements.



Supplier Relationship Management

Build and maintain strong professional relationships with suppliers.

Monitor supplier responsiveness, lead times, pricing, and overall performance.

Conduct supplier performance reviews and maintain supplier scorecards.

Coordinate corrective actions when supplier performance issues arise.

Work closely with suppliers to resolve procurement challenges and minimize operational disruptions.



Cost Optimization

Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and commercial agreements.

Analyze supplier quotations and landed costs.

Benchmark supplier pricing and market conditions.

Identify cost-saving opportunities while maintaining quality and supply reliability.

This is not a passive virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who is comfortable picking up the phone, speaking with business owners and executives, overcoming objections, following up consistently, and asking prospects to schedule the next meeting.

Professional telephone etiquette

Strong grammar and vocabulary

Professional and articulate

Energetic and self-motivated

Persistent without being aggressive

Comfortable speaking with executives and business owners

Outbound calling

B2B telemarketing

Business development

Lead generation

Inside sales

SDR/BDR positions

Cold calling

Customer acquisition

CRM management

U.S.-based customer or client communication

Technology Requirements

Reliable high-speed internet

Reliable computer

High-quality professional headset

Quiet and professional home working environment

Ability to learn and work effectively within our in-house CRM and calling systems

Qualified conversations

Follow-up activities

title: Co-Host / Operations Manager — Guest Experience & Team Lead
description:
The Problem We Need Solved



We run a growing short-term rental business — 18+ units across the East Coast in the United States — and for our guests, the experience begins the 
nt they hit "send" on their very first message. But we've outgrown our current setup:



- Messages need to be answered fast, warmly, and like a real human — not a copy-paste script.

- When something goes sideways, someone has to stay calm and make it right before it becomes a bad review.

- Our small VA team is talented but needs a leader to keep everyone rowing in the same direction.

- Our systems and SOPs need an owner who improves them — not just someone who follows them.



That's where you come in. We're not looking for a "virtual assistant." We're looking for a right-hand operator — a Co-Host who treats our guests like their own and our business like they've got skin in the game.



Your Mission



Be the voice our guests trust and the operator who keeps everything running behind the scenes. You are the first person a guest hears from — and the last line of defense before a small hiccup turns into a one-star surprise.



You'll…



- Own the full guest journey — inquiry, booking, check-in, mid-stay, and checkout — with fast, warm, genuinely human communication.

- Jump on a call when a message won't cut it, and resolve issues calmly in real time.

- Turn frustrated guests into 5-star reviews through sincere, thoughtful recovery.

- Coordinate cleaners, maintenance, and property teams so every turnover is guest-ready.

- Lead, train, and hold accountable a small team of VAs.

- Build and refine the SOPs that make our operation faster and tighter as we scale.

- Spot bottlenecks and bring us ideas on pricing, scheduling, and workflow.

- Handle light social media and admin as needed.



Real Talk — The Heart of This Job



Let's be upfront about what this role actually is: you'll be on the phone with upset guests often. A booking went sideways, the check-in code won't work, the unit isn't what they pictured — and you're the calm, confident voice on the other end. If phone calls with frustrated people wear you down, this isn't the role for you. If you thrive on turning tension into gratitude and finding a fix nobody else spotted, keep reading.



To do this well, you'll need:



- A neutral, no-accent English speaking voice. Guests should never have to strain to understand you. This one is non-negotiable.

- Real de-escalation instincts. You can take someone from furious to thankful in a single conversation, without ever losing your cool.

- Creative problem-solving under pressure. When there's no obvious answer, you invent one — fast, and on your feet.



This Role Is Perfect for Someone Who…



- Can turn an upset guest saying "the AC won't turn on" into a guest who still leaves five stars.

- Reads the emotion behind a message and knows exactly when to type and when to pick up the phone.

- Gets a little rush from closing out a tense situation with one calm, kind reply.

- Treats a clean inbox and a fully-confirmed turnover calendar as a personal win.

- Leads a team the way they'd want to be led — clear, kind, and accountable.

- Constantly asks, "What else can I solve here before anyone even has to ask?"



What You Bring



- Hands-on short-term rental experience (Airbnb, VRBO, 
, or similar).

- Excellent written and spoken English with a truly neutral, no-accent speaking voice — this is non-negotiable, because you'll be on live calls with guests daily.

- Genuine phone confidence. You'll be making and taking calls with upset guests every day, and staying calm under fire is the job — not the exception.

- Proven de-escalation and creative problem-solving. You can turn furious into grateful, and improvise a fix when there's no playbook for the situation in front of you.

- Leadership experience running a small (virtual) team and keeping people accountable.

- Tech-savvy across hospitality platforms — PMS/messaging tools, calendars, Slack, WhatsApp, 
, Hospitable, and the like.

- High EQ, real warmth, and a genuine passion for hospitality.



Your Setup



- Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, a second monitor, and a noise-canceling headset.

- Available for daytime coverage in our market's time zone (US East)— guest issues don't keep office hours.



Compensation & Growth



- Competitive monthly salary (based on experience) plus performance bonuses tied to review scores and guest satisfaction.

- This is a long-term seat with a real path into Operations Lead / Regional roles as we grow. You won't just run the standards — you'll help shape them.



How We Hire



We don't hire off a resume — we hire off mindset.



How do you take feedback? We love people who grow from clear, kind communication.

How do you make decisions? You'll act independently, but always with care.

What's your default mode? Our favorite people ask, "What else can I own here?"



To Apply



Please send both (applications missing either won't be considered):

- Your resume/CV.

- A 1–2 minute English introduction video or voice sample introducing yourself and telling us why this role is the one for you.



NOTE: must be available US EST Day Time and looking for 7 days a week of coverage.

title: Google Ads Strategist - Home Service Businesses (EST, Full Time)
description:
If you cannot commit to working EST hours, do not apply. THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY ROLE.



Sustain Media is a local SEO and Google Ads agency built only for home service businesses. Roofers,

plumbers, HVAC companies, electricians, landscapers, restoration companies, and auto shops. Most of

our clients are owner-operated businesses doing $2M to $10M a year. Our job is simple: more calls and

more booked jobs. Ultimately, every metric has to connect back to qualified leads, booked work, and

profitable growth.



We're hiring a Google Ads Strategist to join our paid media team.



What makes this role different



We use AI agents to handle a growing share of the repetitive work most agencies still do by hand,

including search term mining, campaign audits, performance diagnostics, and reporting data pulls. The

systems get better every month.



Right now, this role includes real implementation work. You'll build campaigns, write ads, make bid

changes, and manage accounts directly. We're moving quickly on AI systems, and over the next few

quarters the role should become increasingly focused on strategy rather than implementation.



That strategy includes understanding why a plumber in Portland needs a different structure than an

HVAC company in Fort Wayne, when to push budget into a seasonal spike, when to pull back, and how

to turn performance data into a growth plan for every account you run.



If you want the strategy-only version of this job on day one, this is not it. If you want to grow into it as the

systems mature, keep reading.



What you'll own



Your own book of clients. You'll own your accounts end to end, working alongside another PPC

specialist who manages a separate portfolio. You'll manage Google Ads across home service accounts

with different trades, markets, budgets, and growth goals. Each account needs its own strategy.



Lead generation. These campaigns exist to drive phone calls, form fills, and booked jobs. You need to

know how to build for that and measure it the way a business owner does: qualified lead volume,

acquisition cost, booked work, and return on spend, not clicks and impressions alone.



Tracking and attribution. A dashboard saying Google is working means nothing if the client's phone is

not ringing. You'll own conversion tracking on every account and know how to verify which campaigns

drive real calls, form fills, and booked jobs.



New account builds. When a client signs, you architect the account from zero, including keyword

research, campaign structure, ad copy, bidding, geo-targeting, conversion tracking, and launch.



Judgment calls. Our AI agent Viktor provides audits and diagnostics. You d
 what to do with them:

which bid strategy fits an account with 20 conversions a month versus 100, when PMax is supporting the

account, when it is obscuring poor lead quality or wasting spend, and when to restructure instead of

continuing to optimize around a flawed setup.



Landing pages and offers. You work with our development and SEO teams so ad traffic lands on pages

that convert. You guide the messaging and structure, but you do not build the pages.

Monthly reporting. Viktor pulls the data. You write the story, explain what changed, and lay out the plan

for the next month.



What success looks like



In your first 90 days, you'll take full ownership of a portfolio, confirm that tracking is trustworthy, identify

the largest performance opportunities, and establish a clear strategy for each account. Longer term,

success means improving qualified lead volume and booked-job economics while keeping clients

confident in the direction of their campaigns.



What we're looking for



Must-haves:

- Proven results running lead generation campaigns for local home service businesses

- Hands-on experience with Search, Performance Max, and Local Service Ads

- A strong understanding of conversion tracking. When a client says the leads are not coming in, 'the

dashboard looks fine' is not an answer. You know how to verify what is real.

- The ability to build an account from zero and defend every major choice you made

- The ability to read data and make strategic recommendations, not just report what a dashboard says

- Strong communication skills. You'll be in Slack daily.

Strong pluses:

- Strong attribution skills, including tracing ad spend through call tracking and offline conversions to

booked jobs

- Experience with CallRail or similar call-tracking platforms

- An understanding of how Google Business Profile and local SEO work together with paid search

- Agency experience managing multiple accounts at once

- Comfort working with AI tools. You do not need to build automations, but you should want to use

them.

The environment

- Remote, international team

- Contractor position, paid biweekly

- Base range: $1,500 to $2,000 USD per month depending on experience

- Revenue share: after a certain amount of time with a client, you will begin earning an ongoing

monthly share tied to how long that client stays with us. Realistically, this adds $200 to $500 per

month within your first year and keeps growing as your book matures. It is paid every month, for as

long as the client stays.



Daily tools: Google Ads, CallRail, Slack, Airtable, Google Sheets, and Viktor



You can work from anywhere in the world, but you work U.S. Eastern Time (EST) business hours.

This is a firm rule, not a preference. There is no time tracking, and there never will be, but the EST

schedule is non-negotiable. If you cannot commit to working EST hours, do not apply.



Our clients are month to month with no long-term contracts. We earn the business every 30 days,

which means the work has to be good.



Small senior team. You work directly with the founder and the operations team

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
Senior Graphic Designer

Childcare Marketing Group | Remote-First | Full-Time







Position Overview



We are looking for a Senior Graphic Designer who can turn strategy into visual impact.

At Childcare Marketing Group, we help childcare centers and early education businesses attract more families, strengthen their brands, and grow. Our creative work is not decoration — it is a critical part of how our clients communicate, compete, and generate results.



As our Senior Graphic Designer, you will take ownership of visual execution across a diverse portfolio of clients. You will work from concept through completion, translating marketing strategies and campaign objectives into creative that is compelling, commercially-minded, and built to perform.



This is not a role for someone who simply waits for a brief and follows instructions.

We want a designer who can think, challenge, create, refine, and raise the creative standard. Someone who understands that great design combines creativity with strategy, knows how to work at speed without sacrificing quality, and has the confidence to own projects from beginning to end.



You will work across multiple projects, brands, and formats while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and consistently delivering work that clients are proud to put their name behind.





Compensation



Competitive Compensation: Based on experience and level of expertise.

Performance Bonuses: Additional earning potential may be available based on performance and company programs.





Why You Should Work Here



? Work That Matters: You help transform lives by supporting the marketing of businesses that care for and educate children. Your creative work helps childcare providers connect with more families who need their services.

? Recession-Proof Growth: Childcare is an essential industry, and our clients need effective marketing to continue attracting families, filling places, and growing their businesses.

? Leadership That Has Your Back: You’ll work with a supportive, attentive, and motivated leadership team that wants you to succeed and gives you the support to keep developing.

? An Owner Who Shows Up: Our owner is actively involved in the business and invested in building a high-performing company and team.

? Small-Team Feel: You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas are visible, your work matters, and you’re treated as a person rather than a headcount.

? Remote-First Flexibility: Work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection while staying closely connected to a collaborative international team.

? Top-of-Market Opportunity: We want exceptional people and believe strong talent should have the opportunity to grow with the company.

? Train to Be the Best: Extensive initial and ongoing training, courses, and professional development designed to help you become exceptionally strong at what you do.

? A Workspace That Feels 
 Our remote environment is designed to keep the team connected, collaborative, and engaged even when we're working from different parts of the world.

? Quarterly Town Halls: Regular company-wide updates so you understand what is happening across the business and where we are heading.

? The Dream-On Program: Our CEO grants multiple wishes each year pulled directly from team members' dream boards.

? 25 Days Off: A full 25 paid days off per year, because great work requires time to recharge and have a life outside work.

? Paid Days to Give Back: 4 paid days each year to volunteer with a charity of your choice.





What Success Looks Like



Within your first 90 days, you will understand our creative standards, clients, workflows, and brand requirements and begin taking full ownership of your design projects.

Ongoing, you will be measured on:

? Creative Quality: Consistently producing polished, original, high-quality creative that meets or exceeds professional agency standards.

? Creative Ownership: Taking projects from initial concept through final delivery with minimal supervision and strong judgment at every stage.

? Brand Consistency: Ensuring every asset reflects the client's brand, audience, positioning, and campaign objectives.

? Strategic Design: Creating visuals that do more than look good — they communicate clearly, support marketing objectives, and contribute to measurable campaign outcomes.

? Speed & Reliability: Managing multiple projects and deadlines without sacrificing quality or allowing important details to slip through the cracks.

? Attention to Detail: Catching inconsistencies, errors, spacing issues, formatting problems, and other details before work reaches the client.

? Collaboration: Working effectively with marketers, strategists, copywriters, account managers, and other creative team members to produce stronger work.

? Client Impact: Creating work that clients value, approve confidently, and can use effectively across their marketing.





A Typical Week Might Include



? Reviewing creative briefs and marketing objectives before translating them into visual concepts.

? Developing concepts, layouts, graphics, advertisements, social media creative, presentations, and other marketing assets.

? Taking a project from rough concept through design, revision, approval, and final delivery.

? Collaborating with Account Managers, Marketing Strategists, copywriters, and other internal specialists.

? Reviewing existing client creative and identifying opportunities to improve visual consistency and effectiveness.

? Managing multiple projects simultaneously while prioritizing deadlines and maintaining quality.

? Presenting creative concepts and explaining the strategic thinking behind your design decisions.

? Responding to feedback, refining creative, and knowing when to push an idea further versus when to move forward.

? Staying current with design trends, creative technology, AI tools, and evolving visual communication practices.





Key Competencies



? Creative Thinker: You generate original ideas rather than simply replicating what already exists.

? Exceptional Attention to Detail: You notice the small things that separate good design from outstanding design.

? Strategic Designer: You understand that design needs to serve an audience, communicate a message, and support a business objective.

? High Standards: You hold your own work to a professional standard and are not satisfied with "good enough."

? Excellent Communicator: You can explain creative decisions clearly and confidently to both internal teammates and professional clients.

? Problem Solver: You can work through unclear briefs, creative challenges, competing priorities, and tight deadlines without becoming stuck.

? Adaptable: You can move between different brands, industries, audiences, and creative requirements without losing quality.

? Time Management Master: You know how to manage your workload, prioritize competing deadlines, and deliver consistently.

? Collaborative: You know when to lead creatively, when to listen, and how to make the people around you better.

? Resilient & Self-Confident: You are comfortable receiving feedback, defending a strong creative idea when appropriate, and continually improving your work.





This Role Is Not for You If



? You need someone to give you exact instructions for every design decision.

? You are primarily interested in making things look attractive without considering the marketing objective behind them.

? You struggle to manage multiple projects or deadlines simultaneously.

? You take creative feedback personally or resist revisions.

? You regularly miss small details that affect the quality of finished work.

? You are uncomfortable working in a fast-moving agency environment where priorities can change.

? You need constant supervision to stay productive.

? You are not interested in continuing to develop your creative skills and staying current with new design tools and trends.









Skills and Experience Required



? 5+ years of professional graphic design experience, with a strong track record of producing commercial, marketing-focused creative in an agency, in-house marketing, advertising, or similarly fast-paced environment. 

? A strong portfolio demonstrating high-level commercial and marketing design work across multiple formats and industries.

? Thorough understanding of graphic design principles, including typography, layout, composition, hierarchy, colour, visual storytelling, and brand consistency.

? Demonstrated ability to take a project from concept through final execution.

? Advanced proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.

? Strong understanding of designing for digital marketing, including social media, paid advertising, web,
, and other digital channels.

? Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.

? Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

? Strong attention to detail and quality control.

? A reliable remote work setup and ability to work independently.





Preferred Skills and Experience



? Previous experience working in a digital marketing or creative agency.

? Experience designing creative specifically for paid advertising and conversion-focused campaigns.

? Experience working across multiple client brands simultaneously.

? Experience with motion graphics, video editing, animation, or other multimedia design.

? Experience with Figma, Canva, or similar collaborative design platforms.

? Familiarity with AI-assisted creative and design tools.

? Experience designing for childcare, education, franchise, healthcare, or other multi-location businesses.

? Experience presenting creative concepts to clients or senior stakeholders.

? Understanding of marketing performance and how creativity can influence engagement, conversion, and acquisition.





Work Environment 

This is a full-time, remote-first position.





About Childcare Marketing Group 

Childcare Marketing Group helps child care centers, day nurseries, and early education businesses attract more families, retain enrollment, and grow with smarter marketing. We are a fast-growing, remote-first marketing company serving clients across the U.S., U.K., and beyond.

title: Outbound Sales Rep - US Freight (Night Shift, Long-Term)
description:
YOU WILL NOT BE COLD-CALLING A PURCHASED LIST.



Every company you call has already shipped freight with us. We are Transam Carriers, a Canadian trucking company in Toronto with our own trucks (120+). We pulled ten years of our own shipping history to build your call list. You will phone a logistics manager and say, in effect: "we moved 40 of your loads to Virginia last year through a broker - we'd like to quote you direct."



That is a completely different conversation from a cold list, and it is why this role actually works.



THE JOB

Call companies from that list and book 15-minute "lane review" meetings for our sales team. That is the whole job. You do not quote prices, you do not negotiate, you do not close - our Canadian sales manager does all of that. You start the conversation.



- 60-80 dials per day into Ontario and US-East manufacturers and distributors

- Everything runs in our own CRM: click-to-dial, call outcomes, callbacks, notes

- An AI assistant writes a call script for each lead from that company's real freight history before you dial

- You get a company phone extension and a Canadian caller ID

- Weekly 15-minute pipeline review with the sales manager



SCHEDULE (please read carefully)

Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM US Eastern = 9:00 PM - 3:00 AM Manila time. This is a permanent night shift. Please only apply if you have done US-hours night shift before and know you can sustain it.



PAY

- $1,200 - $1,400 USD per month base, depending on experience

- Plus $75 for every lane-review meeting that is held and qualified

- Plus $250 when a company you sourced books its first load with us

- Realistic total once you are up to speed: $1,800 - $2,200 USD per month

- Paid twice monthly, on time, every time

- We start with a short paid trial on live leads, then it is a long-term role. We want one person to grow with this for years, not a short campaign.



WHO WE WANT

- 2+ years of outbound phone sales or appointment setting, ideally B2B

- Excellent spoken English - a busy Ontario shipping manager must want to stay on the line. This is the single most important requirement

- Freight / logistics BPO background (carrier sales, dispatch, track-and-trace, brokerage support) is a big plus but NOT required - we will teach you freight

- Reliable electricity, wired internet, quiet room, good headset

- Someone who can handle rejection all night and still sound warm on dial number 61



HOW TO APPLY - follow this exactly or we will skip your application



1. Put the word REEFER at the very start of your application. We are checking who reads to the end.

2. Tell us your real outbound numbers: dials per day, conversations per day, and what you were booking or closing.

3. Attach or link a 60-90 second voice recording in English introducing yourself and telling us about the toughest sales call you ever turned around. This is a phone job - we need to hear you. Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.



OUR HIRING PROCESS

Voice recording review, then a short structured voice screening, then a recorded phone interview with our AI interviewer (arranged with you in advance, includes a short live sales roleplay), then a mock cold call with our sales manager, then a short paid trial, then the long-term role. We reply to every applicant either way.

title: High-Performance Executive Assistant (U.S. Tax & Executive Operations)

Who We Are



DAP Brands is a community of high performers building businesses that create real impact.



Our leadership team moves quickly, thinks strategically, and expects people to solve problems—not simply complete tasks.



We value:



-Speed

-Accountability

-Precision

-Emotional maturity

-Ownership

-Loyalty to the mission (not ego)



What This Role Really Is



This role combines Executive Support, Financial Operations, Data Analysis, and Business Execution.



Your primary responsibility is to help leadership make better decisions by organizing financial and operational information into clear, actionable insights.



You'll support executive initiatives while ensuring critical business, accounting, and tax-related information is accurate, organized, and decision-ready.



You'll help:



-Organize and analyze financial, operational, and business data

-Prepare executive reports, dashboards, and KPI tracking

-Review accounting, bookkeeping, and U.S. tax-related reports for accuracy and completeness

-Assist leadership in monitoring financial performance and operational metrics

-Protect your executive's time by managing priorities and follow-through

-Drive accountability across leadership initiatives

-Identify operational gaps and recommend process improvements

-Translate strategy into structured execution

title: Surface Pattern Designer — Textile Print
description:
Surface Pattern Designer — Textile Print



Remote, freelance/contract 



About us



We are a fast-growing ecommerce apparel-accessories brand built on cotton bandanas and silk scarves. Our aesthetic sits at the crossroads of fashion, urban streetwear and western freedom, and our community is urban fashion, cottagecore fashion, riders, hikers, festival-goers, and musicians who want gear that keeps up with them.



The role



We're looking for a true artist — someone who understands that a bandana or a scarf can tell a story, not just carry a pattern. You'll create original, production-ready textile prints for our cotton bandana and silk scarf lines — from classic paisley and toile de jouy to western-inspired and botanical motifs — carrying a concept from initial sketch through to a fully color-separated, print-ready file our factory can run.



What you'll do

Design original repeat patterns and motifs for cotton bandanas and silk scarves, across formats from 22x22" up to oversized 27x27" and larger scarf sizes

Develop each pattern across multiple colorways for pack-based collections (typically 3-5 colors per collection)

Work within screen-printing color constraints and prepare fully vector-separated, print-ready artwork

Match colors to Pantone TCX references for cotton pieces; for silk, work with the mill on lab-dip approval against the same TCX reference number, since silk's sheen renders color more saturated than the matte cotton swatch

Balance heritage pattern references (paisley, toile de jouy, provençal, ditsy florals) with current textile print trends, benchmarking social media and fashion trend platforms (Pinterest, Instagram, TikTok) to keep direction current

Develop concepts from initial sketches and mood references through to fully hand-refined, original, licensable artwork

Contribute to new collection roadmaps and help scope pattern direction for upcoming product lines



What you bring

Fashion industry experience — you've designed for apparel or textile brands, not just generic graphic design

Strong portfolio specifically in textile/surface pattern design — include repeat patterns, not just standalone illustrations

Expert-level Adobe Illustrator (repeat construction: straight, half-drop, mirror) and Photoshop

Understanding of screen-printing production constraints and color separation

Experience matching artwork to Pantone (TCX) physical references

Knowledge of classic/heritage textile pattern traditions, plus an eye for current print trends

An artist's eye — able to build a scene or a story into a pattern, not just repeat a motif

Comfortable taking a project from rough concept to fully production-ready file independently



Nice to have

Experience designing for bandanas, scarves, or other small-format square textiles

Background in western/Americana, bohemian, or heritage-print aesthetics

Fine art or illustration background alongside textile/surface design



Details

Freelance/contract, remote, ongoing — one pattern/collection at a time to start, with room to grow



To apply



Send your portfolio with a focus on repeat pattern / textile print work, plus one example of a print you've taken all the way to production-ready, color-separated artwork — tell us about the story behind it.

title: AI Image Generator (2D to realistic 3D Conversion)
description:
The Work



This is a simple, repetitive task. We give you a 2D image and the prompt. You generate the 3D version, check that the details match, and send it back. No design skills needed. What matters is that you check your work carefully.



These images are used by students studying for their Dutch driving theory exam (theorie-examen voor het rijbewijs), so accuracy matters more than artistic freedom. Every detail that carries meaning in the original must survive into the 3D version: road markings, lane lines, zebra crossings, shark's teeth, traffic signs, vehicle positions, and sight lines. It does not need to be pixel-identical, but if a sign moves to the other side of the road or a marking disappears, the exercise no longer makes sense for the student. This is the main challenge of the role, and it is why we need someone who pays close attention rather than someone who just runs a prompt and moves on.



What we provide:



- The 2D source image for every scene

- The prompt that produces the visual style we want

- Example outputs showing exactly what we expect



What we are looking for:



- Strong practical skill with AI image generation and prompt iteration

- Sharp eye for detail and the discipline to compare output against source before delivering

- Willingness to redo an image when a detail is wrong



We use Gemini and it works well for this. If you are confident in a different tool, tell us which one and why, and we are open to it.



You do not need to know Dutch traffic rules. We will point out what matters in each scene, and you will need to adjust as you learn what to watch for. We do not expect perfect results on day one.



To apply



Tell us which AI image tools you use. We will send an example 2D image and the expected 3D result so you can see the standard before you commit.

title: Pagedeck Designer / Website Builder
description:
Pagedeck Designer / Website Builder



About us



We're an established toys and games brand coming off one of the most successful sport-related backyard game products in the category — and we're just getting started. We're now transitioning into a full sports toys and games company, speed-running zero to one million customers over the next three years.



To do it, we need specialist help with web development — building websites, landing pages, listicles and more, based on our criteria.



The role



We have a strong vision of what our rebrand and new website should loosely look like — we need a designer to bring those concepts to life and make the site and pages look great while functioning extremely well on all devices, especially mobile.



Until now, page design and website builds have been done by the founders, which has meant slow progress and lower-quality functionality. We're looking for an expert to craft incredibly high-converting, high-functioning pages that maximize buying behaviour. You will also constantly make suggestions on ways we can improve performance, from a conversion rate perspective.



What you'll work on

-The rebrand build — translating our concepts, references and briefs into a polished new site that's fast, on-brand and flawless on mobile.

-High-converting landing pages and listicles — dedicated pages for hero products, offers and paid traffic campaigns, built to sell.

-Conversion-focused iteration — creating page variants for testing, and making data-driven tweaks to layouts, sections and CTAs to lift conversion rate.

-UGC and social proof integration — weaving creator content, reviews and press into pages in ways that build trust and drive purchases.

-Speed and performance — keeping load times sharp and pages functioning perfectly across devices and browsers.

-Ongoing page needs — seasonal updates, promo pages and new page builds as the brand and product range grows.



We're currently sold on making this new site work on Pagedeck.



Who we're looking for:



-Direct, hands-on experience building sites and landing pages in Pagedeck (preferable).

-A portfolio of ecommerce pages that convert — you think like a marketer, not just a designer.

-Strong mobile-first instincts; most of our traffic buys on a phone.

-Fast turnaround and clear communication — you can take a brief and run with it.

-Organized and reliable: you deliver what you say, when you say.

-Somebody who isn't just a wiz on page builders, they can also implement custom code and CSS to suit our needs.



How to apply:



Send us links to pages or sites you've built, with a line or two on what you did and any results they drove. No cover letters needed — show us your work.



Please answer both screening questions below. Applications with unanswered screening questions will be automatically disqualified.



This starts part-time with flexible hours, but for the right person there's plenty of ongoing work as we scale. We also have a 2nd brand in a different industry where you would eventually be implemented for the correct candidate.



Screening Questions

1. How much experience do you have with Pagedeck, or based on our scope and requirements, would you suggest another platform or way to build out our needs?

2. Do you have much experience with building custom features on websites? Such as custom carts, implementing CSS, HTML etc.?



Important: Both screening questions must be answered. Applications with unanswered screening questions will be automatically disqualified.

title: SOC Analyst (Level 1–2)
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a SOC Analyst (Level 1–2) to join our Security Operations team. In this role, you will be responsible for triaging security alerts, conducting in-depth investigations, performing root cause analysis (RCA), and recommending or executing remediation steps. You'll work across a modern security stack including Microsoft Sentinel, Defender, FortiGate, Netskope, ObserveIT, Auvik, and NinjaRMM - and you'll leverage AI-assisted analysis tools (including Claude) to accelerate investigation and response.



This is a hands-on, technically rigorous role for someone who thrives on solving puzzles, communicating clearly under pressure, and constantly leveling up their security craft.



Key Responsibilities



Alert Triage & Monitoring

Monitor security alerts and events across Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender (Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps, Office 365), Netskope, FortiGate firewalls, ObserveIT, Auvik, and NinjaRMM.

Perform initial triage of incoming alerts: validate fidelity, classify severity, assign priority, and determine whether an alert is a true positive, false positive, or benign true positive.

Acknowledge, document, and escalate alerts per defined SLAs and runbooks.

Maintain situational awareness across multiple client environments, tenants, and Azure stack workloads (AVD, Azure VMs, Azure AD/Entra ID, Azure networking).



Investigation & Root Cause Analysis

Conduct detailed investigations into security i
 — pivoting across logs, endpoint telemetry, network flows, identity signals, and user activity to build a full picture of what happened.

Construct timelines of events, identify the initial access vector, lateral movement, and impact.

Perform root cause analysis (RCA) to determine the underlying conditions that allowed an i
 to occur (misconfiguration, missing control, user behavior, vulnerability, etc.).

Use Microsoft Sentinel KQL queries to hunt across log sources, build investigations, and validate hypotheses.

Leverage AI-assisted tools (including Claude) to accelerate log analysis, summarize findings, draft queries, and support investigation workflows - while maintaining analyst judgment and validation.



Response & Next Steps

Recommend and, where authorized, execute containment and remediation actions (isolating endpoints, disabling accounts, blocking IOCs at the firewall or proxy, revoking sessions, etc.).

Coordinate with Tier 3 / IR specialists and client-facing teams to hand off complex i
 with complete context.

Document clear, actionable next steps for clients — including technical remediation, policy changes, user education, and follow-up validation.

Produce concise, professional i
 write-ups suitable for both technical and non-technical client audiences.



Continuous Improvement

Tune detection rules and analytics in Sentinel and Defender to reduce false positives and improve signal quality.

Contribute to and maintain SOC runbooks, playbooks, and standard operating procedures.

Identify recurring i
 patterns and recommend systemic improvements (control gaps, configuration drift, training opportunities).

Stay current on threat intelligence, emerging TTPs, and vulnerabilities relevant to client environments.



Required Qualifications

Experience: 1–3+ years in a SOC, NOC with security responsibilities, MSP/MSSP, IT security, or similar hands-on role.

SIEM: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel, including writing and tuning KQL queries.

Microsoft Security Stack: Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender (Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps, O365) and Azure AD / Entra ID.

Azure: Familiarity with Azure stack components — Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Azure VMs, Azure networking, and core IAM concepts.

Network Security: Practical experience reading FortiGate firewall logs, policies, and traffic flows.

Endpoint & Cloud Tools: Exposure to Netskope (SWG/CASB), ObserveIT (or similar UAM/insider risk), NinjaRMM (or comparable RMM), and Auvik (or comparable network monitoring).

Investigation Skills: Demonstrated ability to perform structured triage, root cause analysis, and produce clear i
 documentation.

Foundations: Solid grasp of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP(S), authentication protocols, common attack techniques (MITRE ATT&CK), and Windows event logs.

Communication: Strong written and verbal communication — able to explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.

Mindset: Curiosity, attention to detail, and the discipline to follow process without losing the ability to think critically.



Preferred Qualifications

Industry certifications such as Security+, AZ-500, SC-200, SC-900, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, or equivalent.

Experience in an MSP or MSSP environment supporting multiple client tenants.

Scripting / automation experience (PowerShell, Python, KQL functions, Logic Apps, Sentinel playbooks).

Experience integrating or working with AI-assisted security tooling (e.g., Claude, Security Copilot) for investigation and reporting workflows.

Exposure to threat intelligence platforms, EDR forensic workflows, and basic malware triage.

Familiarity with compliance frameworks (NIST CSF, CIS, HIPAA, SOC 2).



What You'll Get

A modern, well-instrumented security stack with real depth across endpoint, network, identity, and cloud.

Direct exposure to a wide variety of environments and i
 types — accelerated growth vs. a single-enterprise SOC.

Access to AI-assisted tooling that augments (not replaces) your analytical work.

Clear mentorship from senior analysts and a defined progression path from Tier 1 to Tier 2 and beyond.

Support for certifications and ongoing training.



Working Conditions

This role may include shift work or on-call rotation to support SOC coverage requirements.

Remote, hybrid, or onsite arrangements per AlphaRidge policy.

AlphaRidge is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: SENIOR SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR - CLOUD INFRASTRUCTURE
description:
SENIOR SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR - CLOUD INFRASTRUCTURE

Microsoft 365, Azure, and Google Workspace

 

Company: AlphaRidge

 

About Us:

AlphaRidge is a New York based managed IT and cybersecurity firm serving healthcare, financial services, and public sector organizations. We run an integrated Security Operations Center and Network Operations Center, and our clients operate under HIPAA, SOC 2, and comparable compliance obligations. We are a certified Minority and Women Owned Business Enterprise.

 

The Role:

This is a senior technical seat, not a support queue role. You will own the cloud platform layer of our managed services practice and act as the escalation point above our System Administrators for anything touching tenant configuration, identity, or cloud infrastructure.

 

Roughly 80 percent of our clients run Microsoft environments, so Microsoft 365 and Azure are where your depth must be strongest. The remainder run Google Workspace or mixed environments, and you will support those with the same standard of care.

 

Your shift extends our engineering day. You start with a live handoff at the end of the US business day, then carry escalations and project work through the US evening. Work handed off to you is moving again by the US team's next morning. For you, this is a normal daytime schedule, roughly 5:00 AM to 2:00 PM Philippine Time, Monday to Friday.

 

You will work as a full member of one engineering team, not as an offshore extension of it. You will hold your own client relationships and own your own projects. Our SOC and NOC handle alerting, so you are not carrying monitoring on top of engineering.

 

Key Responsibilities:

- Own configuration, hardening, and lifecycle management of client Microsoft 365 tenants: identity, conditional access, mail, collaboration, and information governance

- Design and administer Azure infrastructure: networking, compute, storage, backup and recovery, and role based access control

- Administer Google Workspace environments for the portion of our client base that runs them

- Serve as the senior escalation point for Level 2 and Level 3 cloud identity, mail flow, licensing, and workload issues

- Plan and lead tenant to tenant, cross platform, and on premises to cloud migrations, including cutover planning

- Administer endpoint management: device and application configuration, compliance policy, and modern enrollment

- Build PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation for provisioning, reporting, and repeatable configuration

- Maintain client documentation and runbooks to an audit ready standard, and follow change control on production changes

- Mentor System Administrators and Service Desk engineers

 

Requirements:

- 6+ years in systems administration, with at least 3 years administering Microsoft 365 at tenant level

- Production Azure experience: networking, compute, backup and recovery, and role based access control

- Advanced Entra ID experience: conditional access, hybrid identity, and privileged role management

- Strong Exchange Online administration, including mail flow troubleshooting and message trace

- Proven migration delivery as a lead, not just a participant

- Intune administration across device compliance and application deployment

- Working PowerShell proficiency, including Microsoft Graph and Exchange Online modules

- Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and certificate services

- Prior experience supporting North American or other international clients at an MSP

- Excellent written and spoken English; you will be client-facing

- Working familiarity with Google Workspace administration, or the ability to reach production competence quickly

- Reliable home setup: 25+ Mbps primary internet, a backup connection, backup power, and a quiet space for client calls

 

Preferred:

- Microsoft certifications: MS-102, AZ-104, AZ-500, or SC-300

The most important thing we’re looking for is independence and good judgment.



I do not have time to provide timestamps or detailed editing instructions for every video.



I need someone who can receive raw footage, review it, identify the best moments, recognize the story or educational value, and turn it into high-quality content with minimal direction.



I want someone who eventually gets to know our brand well enough that I can hand over footage and trust them to find the content inside it.



Responsibilities



* Review and organize raw footage

* Identify strong content opportunities without being given timestamps

* Edit Instagram Reels, TikToks,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts

* Create strong hooks, captions/subtitles, and engaging pacing

* Repurpose longer footage into multiple pieces of content

* Edit longer YouTube and educational videos when appropriate

* Help develop and maintain a consistent CRK9 editing style and brand identity

* Suggest new content ideas based on available footage

* Help identify recurring content series and formats that we can produce consistently



Content Research & Strategy



Part of your paid working time will include researching successful creators and brands in dog training, working dogs, retrievers, outdoor/hunting, military/law enforcement, and educational content.



We want you to identify:



* Effective hooks and opening sequences

* Video structures that hold attention

* Editing and storytelling techniques

* Successful recurring content series

* Thumbnail and title concepts

* Long-form vs. short-form opportunities

* Ways creators turn educational expertise into engaging content

* Content concepts that could be adapted to CRK9



We are not interested in copying other creators. We want to understand what is working, why it works, and develop original CRK9 content using those principles.



Opportunity to Grow



This position can eventually grow beyond editing into a larger Content Manager / Social Media Manager role involving:



* Content planning

* Content calendars

* Scheduling and publishing

* Social media management

* Performance analytics

* YouTube management

* Content strategy

* Helping determine what we should film next based on what’s performing



We value storytelling, initiative, reliability, creativity, organization, and good judgment more than flashy editing effects.



The right person should ultimately make content creation easier for us, not create another job for us to manage.



Candidates we’re interested in will complete a short paid test using actual CRK9 footage before we make a final hiring decision.

title: Youtube Editor/Strategist For Christian Non-Profit
description:
I am looking for Youtube Strategist & Editor who has experience both on the creative side of youtube (thumbnails, shorts editing, andding end screens, etc.) and on the data/strategy (A/B testing thumbnails, how to monetize, improving retention, video funnel strategy). Really just someone who can take the raw content that this ministry provides and run with it. I understand the majority of you will use AI to apply, but those who do not will be given heavy preference, as we are looking for someone who is passionate about this, not the best at selling themselves.



I am working with a christian ministry (yt channel is: inspiring courageous faith) looking to spread the gospel via their content. They have a small budget to spend on YT ads to grow subs, but really want to improve organically. we have a relatively fixed budget and need to ensure every dollar is being spent wisely. We are also looking for someone who shares our christian values. For those of you who may charge more than the rate we are looking to pay, I am working with this non-profit on a strictly volunteer basis, so if anyone shares their values and would like to offer their services at a discount, that would be incredible (this is obviously a long shot, so no worries if that isn't you, it's not a deal breaker either)



The owner has worked with the past agency for 7 years, even after being incredibly disappointed in results, because he is incredibly loyal to his people, so whoever we choose will likely be with us for many years, and you will be given plenty of time to execute your strategy. this is not a month 1 start up role with the need for quick execution and results, but a established non-profit with the time to propoerly execute and iterate on a strategy. 



You would be working directly with the non-profits team. If you handle strategy, and want to subcontract the creative piece, we have no problem with that as long as you are incharge of the outcomes



Their current agency has provided them with very poor service in the following areas.



reporting: this has been an AI generated nightmare of long convoluted
s with a bunch of number and "analysis" of the number without any actionable steps or insight beyond the obvious

Youtube SEO: no insight into what is being done here, what is working, no A/B testing

Editing/Design: just copy paste, no reels. huge room for improvement here



We are totally open to any strategy you see fit, as long as you are confident and can explain why you want to pursue it. this is very much a hands off role. the team at the non-profit wants someone they can trust to execute entirely on their own



Given a budget of $1000 a month for your services, and a $500 budget for YT ads, with them producing about 4 - 30 min podcasts a week, what all would we get from you? explain your strategy, deliverables on a weekly basis, etc. This plus your specific relevant experience is the only thing I care about in your cover letter.
