title: HubSpot CRM & Recruitment Automation Specialist
description:
About Klinger Insurance Group



Klinger Insurance Group has been proudly serving clients since 1993 and is a trusted independent insurance agency based in Germantown, Maryland. We specialize in Auto, Home, Life, and Commercial Insurance, delivering personalized service and building long-term client relationships.



As our company continues to grow, we are investing in technology to streamline and scale our recruitment operations. We are looking for a HubSpot CRM & Recruitment Automation Specialist to build and optimize a recruitment system within HubSpot that improves candidate experience, recruiter efficiency, and hiring visibility.



About the Role



We are seeking an experienced HubSpot CRM & Recruitment Automation Specialist to design, implement, and optimize our recruitment workflow using HubSpot CRM.



This role will be responsible for transforming HubSpot into a centralized recruitment management system by building automated hiring pipelines, managing candidate records, improving recruiter workflows, integrating recruitment platforms, and ensuring data accuracy across the hiring process.



The ideal candidate has strong experience with HubSpot CRM administration, workflow automation, data management, and system integrations, with the ability to customize HubSpot beyond traditional sales and marketing use cases.



Key Responsibilities



HubSpot Recruitment CRM Administration & Optimization

Serve as the primary administrator for HubSpot CRM used for recruitment operations.

Design, build, and optimize recruitment pipelines, hiring stages, and candidate lifecycle workflows.

Create and maintain automated workflows for candidate communications, interview scheduling, follow-ups, reminders, and hiring notifications.



Configure custom objects, properties, pipelines, associations, and recruitment-specific data structures.

Develop recruiter dashboards and reports to monitor hiring performance, candidate progression, and recruitment KPIs.

Continuously improve recruitment processes by identifying automation opportunities and eliminating manual tasks.



Recruitment Process Automation

Build end-to-end recruitment workflows within HubSpot.

Automate candidate movement between hiring stages.

Configure automated
 sequences for applicants throughout the recruitment process.

Develop recruiter task automation and internal notifications.

Support interview scheduling and recruiter workflow management.

Standardize recruitment processes across hiring teams.



Data Integrity & Recruitment Governance

Maintain accurate and organized candidate records within HubSpot.

Perform regular database audits, duplicate management, and data cleanup.

Establish naming conventions, property governance, and documentation standards.

Ensure consistency and integrity across all recruitment records.

Support recruitment data migration and historical candidate imports



Workflow Monitoring & Quality Assurance

Monitor workflow performance and automation health.

Test and validate workflow logic, automation triggers, candidate routing, and recruiter notifications.

Troubleshoot workflow issues and optimize system performance.

Maintain recruitment dashboards and ensure reporting accuracy.

Recommend scalable improvements to recruitment operations.



System Integration & Technical Support

Integrate HubSpot with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), job boards, scheduling tools, forms, and other recruitment platforms.



Support API integrations using HubSpot Operations Hub or third-party integration tools.

Validate data synchronization between HubSpot and connected systems.

Document system architecture, workflows, and automation processes.

Stay current with HubSpot platform updates and recommend new features that improve recruitment operations.



Qualifications

Required

3+ years of hands-on HubSpot CRM administration experience.

Strong experience building HubSpot workflows and automation.

Experience customizing HubSpot CRM using custom objects, pipelines, properties, and associations.

Experience managing CRM data integrity and governance.

Experience with HubSpot Sales Hub and Operations Hub.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent documentation and communication skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects independently.



Preferred

Experience building recruitment or HR systems within HubSpot.

Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).

Knowledge of recruitment operations and hiring workflows.

Experience integrating HubSpot with third-party platforms using APIs, Zapier, Make (Integromat), or similar tools.

Familiarity with reporting and dashboard development.

HubSpot certifications are highly preferred.





Success in This Role

The successful candidate will help Klinger Insurance Group build a scalable recruitment infrastructure by:

Creating an efficient recruitment CRM within HubSpot.

Automating repetitive recruiting tasks.

Improving recruiter productivity.

Maintaining clean and accurate candidate data.

Delivering reliable recruitment reporting and analytics.

Enhancing the candidate experience through timely and automated communication.

Supporting continuous improvement of recruitment operations through automation and technology.

If you're passionate about HubSpot, automation, and building innovative recruitment systems, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Growth Marketer
description:
About Company



Our company helps people find remote jobs they'll love doing. We pull fresh listings straight from company career pages, so the 200,000+ remote workers who use us see roles while they're still open, not weeks later on a stale board.



About the role



This is a hands-on growth role for someone with high agency who can identify opportunities, prioritize experiments, execute them, measure their commercial impact, and keep improving the system with little to no direction.



You will own the complete job-seeker revenue funnel. You will work directly with the founder on what drives revenue: landing pages, offers,
 campaigns, onboarding, pricing, retention, partnerships, SEO conversion, and growth experiments. 

  

You should be comfortable operating with limited resources, making decisions independently, and being accountable for revenue—not vanity metrics.



What you will own



Conversion and monetization

  - Audit and improve the journey from organic landing pages and job listings to Premium purchase.

  - Increase conversion across our quiz,
 capture, matched-job results, paywall, checkout, and abandoned-checkout flows.

  - Develop and test positioning, offers, pricing, plan structure, guarantees, promotions, and upgrade prompts.

  - Write and implement landing-page, paywall, and checkout copy.

  - Find and fix the largest revenue leaks across the funnel.



Lifecycle and retention

  - Own lead nurturing, onboarding, activation, retention, renewal, cancellation, and win-back communication.

  - Improve the existing
 sequence and build behavioral campaigns around user intent and activity.

  - Increase Premium adoption through job alerts, advanced filters, saved jobs, talent profiles, and other product features.

  - Create systems for learning why customers subscribe, cancel, renew, and recommend our company.

  - Reduce avoidable churn and improve subscriber lifetime value.



Organic growth

  - Turn our company's existing SEO traffic, job pages, advice library, and lead magnets into more qualified leads and paying customers.

  - Identify high-intent content and landing-page opportunities connected to subscription revenue.

  - Build partnerships, affiliates, referrals, communities, and other repeatable non-paid acquisition channels.

  - Repurpose existing research, customer stories, and job-search resources into revenue-producing campaigns.

  - Work on organic distribution directly instead of simply producing a content calendar.



Analytics and experimentation

  - Establish clear reporting for MRR, new subscriptions, plan mix, funnel conversion, retention, churn, LTV, and revenue by

    source.

  - Use tools such as Plausible, Stripe, SQL, spreadsheets, and internal data to diagnose opportunities.

  - Maintain a prioritized experiment backlog based on expected revenue impact.

  - Define a hypothesis and success metric before launching an experiment.

  - Report what changed, what happened, what was learned, and what happens next.

  - Separate meaningful revenue improvements from vanity metrics and misleading attribution.



What success looks like



First 30 days

  - Understand the product, customers, traffic sources, subscription economics, and existing funnel.

  - Validate analytics and establish a reliable revenue scorecard.

  - Identify the largest conversion and retention opportunities.

  - Launch several focused, measurable improvements.



Within 60 days

  - Establish a consistent weekly experimentation cadence.

  - Improve at least one important funnel conversion rate.

  - Launch or improve lifecycle campaigns for onboarding, abandoned checkout, retention, and win-back.

  - Produce an evidence-based plan for pricing, packaging, organic acquisition, and churn reduction.



Within 90 days

  - Demonstrate measurable incremental subscription revenue.

  - Have a working growth system with clear funnel reporting and an organized experiment backlog.

  - Show progress in conversion, subscriber retention, plan mix, or another agreed revenue driver.

  - Establish at least one promising repeatable non-paid growth channel beyond existing traffic.

  

You may be a strong fit if you

  - Have 4+ years of hands-on growth experience in a consumer subscription, SaaS, marketplace, job-search, education, career, or

    digital membership business.

  - Have personally improved paid conversion, recurring revenue, retention, or LTV—not merely supported someone else who owned the

    result.

  - Can provide specific examples with starting metrics, actions taken, and measurable revenue outcomes.

  - Understand conversion optimization, lifecycle
, onboarding, pricing, retention, SEO, partnerships, and referral loops.

  - Can write persuasive, credible conversion copy without depending on a copywriter for every experiment. Using AI is encouraged.

  - Are comfortable analyzing funnels, cohorts, customer behavior, and subscription economics.

  - Can execute with lightweight tools and collaborate with engineering when product changes are required.

  - Work independently, communicate clearly, and know how to prioritize when there are more ideas than resources.



Useful additional skills

  - Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, EJS, or similar template systems.

  - Ability to query data with SQL.

  - Experience with Stripe subscriptions and billing data.

  - Experience building affiliate, referral, partnership, or community programs.

  - Experience converting organic search traffic into subscription revenue.

  - Familiarity with job boards, marketplaces, career products, or international consumer audiences.



This role is not for someone who

  - Specializes primarily in paid advertising or media buying.

  - Wants to manage agencies without doing hands-on execution.

  - Measures success mainly through impressions, followers, traffic, or
 volume.

  - Produces strategies and presentations but waits for others to implement them.

  - Needs a large team before they can make progress.

  - Has only B2B lead-generation experience without consumer subscription or transactional growth exposure.





How to apply

 

 Please send:

  1. A short introduction explaining why this role fits your experience with your resume (
words)

  2. Two examples where you personally grew subscription or transactional revenue without relying primarily on paid advertising. For each example, include the baseline, your diagnosis, what you executed, the result, and how long it took. (
words)

  3. An example of a landing page,
 sequence, retention program, partnership, SEO funnel, or pricing experiment you personally created. (
words)

  4. Your location, availability, expected compensation, and notice period.

title: Executive Assistant to Chief of Sales
description:
About the Role



This is a right-hand role to the founder of Effortless Hire (VA staffing agency) and Side Hustle (live entrepreneurship game show). Think executive assistant plus: you own the founder's inbox, calendar, follow-ups, and pipeline so he can stay focused on selling and relationships — and you build and run the systems that make that possible.



This is not a maintain-what-exists role. Several core systems are being stood up right now — the Attio CRM, the founder's newsletter,
 flows — and you will help build them, then own them.



You will work alongside an AI Chief of Staff (Claude) that manages the founder's Notion operating system. Your superpower is taking a rough instruction and returning work that is 85–90% done. AI fluency is a requirement, not a bonus.



Starts part-time (~20 hrs/week), designed to grow into full-time as trust builds.



First 90 Days



Take over the founder's inbox and calendar

Stand up Attio CRM: Gmail/calendar sync, pipeline design, triage the relationship backlog, get the follow-up rhythm running

Launch the founder's newsletter system: platform setup, list build, sending cadence

Own the follow-up backlog so no opportunity sits cold



Core Responsibilities



1. Executive Support (the foundation)



• Own and organize the founder's Gmail inbox: triage, flag, draft replies

• Manage calendar and scheduling; protect focus blocks

• Track commitments from meetings and make sure they happen

• Prepare for calls: context briefs, follow-up recaps

• Handle sensitive communications with discretion and polish



2. CRM & Deal Flow (build it, then run it)



• Help set up Attio CRM from scratch: sync, pipelines, views, relationship states

• Maintain the founder's relationship pipeline (clients, referral partners, sponsors, collaborators)

• Monitor threads and surface anything needing follow-up — nothing falls through the cracks

• Draft follow-up and recap
s in the founder's voice (direct, tight, no corporate language)

• Manage warm-before-cold outreach sequencing and meeting scheduling



3. Systems & Marketing Builds



• Stand up the founder's newsletter: platform, list migration, templates, cadence

• Support
 flows and website/marketing system builds as they come online

• Coordinate with designers, editors, and specialists for heavier assets

• Light asset work in Canva





4. Project Coordination & Specialist Management



• Track initiatives across Effortless Hire and Side Hustle in Notion; break them into next steps

• Coordinate execution with internal VAs and specialists; monitor deadlines

• When extra hands are needed: work with the EH recruiting team, tap the existing VA talent pool, run trials, and project-manage the specialist



5. Knowledge Capture & Content Support



• Mine Fathom call recordings for insights, action items, and testimonial moments

• Turn call gold into draft LinkedIn posts and newsletter material

title: SEO Manager
description:
The Opportunity:

We are seeking an experienced SEO Manager to own and execute SEO work across our active client portfolio. This is a highly hands-on full time position responsible for turning established search strategy into account-level plans and executing the technical SEO, on-page optimization, local search, link building, content direction, migrations, and reporting required to deliver results.



The ideal candidate combines strong technical SEO expertise with excellent organization, accountability, and communication. You should be comfortable independently managing competing priorities, identifying risks early, and proactively bringing forward recommendations and opportunities.



Key Responsibilities:



SEO Strategy & Account Management:

- Build and execute account-level SEO roadmaps based on established strategy and methodology.

- Manage priorities and deliverables across the full portfolio of active SEO accounts.

- Ensure contracted SEO work is completed accurately and on schedule.

- Identify scope, capacity, or delivery risks and escalate them proactively.

- Conduct competitive, keyword, content gap, and opportunity analysis.



Technical & On-Page SEO:

- Perform technical SEO audits and implement recommendations.

- Manage site architecture, internal linking, URL structures, redirects, crawlability, and indexation.

- Implement schema markup and structured data.

- Monitor and improve Core Web Vitals and page performance.

- Perform routine SEO and configuration work directly within WordPress.

- Plan and execute website migrations, consolidations, and large-scale URL restructuring.



Local SEO & Link Building:

- Manage Google Business Profile optimization, governance, categories, duplicates, and suspensions.

- Develop local landing page and location strategies.

- Identify and evaluate link-building opportunities and placements.

- Manage anchor text, target URL strategies, citations, and link budgets.

- Review and quality-check work completed by the local search resource.



Content & Search Visibility:

- Develop SEO-focused content briefs based on search intent.

- Apply topical clusters and resource hub strategies.

- Optimize content for traditional search and emerging AI-driven search experiences.

- Strengthen EEAT signals, authorship, credentials, and entity consistency.

- Incorporate SEO, AIO, AEO, GEO, and local search into account planning.



Reporting & Client Communication:

- Monitor rankings, organic traffic, conversions, traffic quality, and AI visibility.

- Maintain accurate reporting and performance data.

- Turn performance data into actionable recommendations.

- Participate in recurring client calls and respond to SEO-related questions.

- Communicate delays, blockers, risks, and performance issues proactively.



Team & Operational Support:

- Manage and develop a part-time local search resource.

- Delegate responsibilities as capabilities develop.

- Follow and improve established SEO SOPs, templates, and checklists.

- Document account-specific processes and technical decisions clearly.

- Support onboarding of new SEO accounts.

- Conduct SEO audits and competitive analysis for qualified prospects.



Compensation:

Competitive monthly compensation based on experience and role scope.



Monthly compensation ranges from ?70,000 – ?90,000, depending on experience and role scope. Final compensation is aligned with the candidate’s experience level.



Required Experience:

- 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably within an agency or performance-driven environment.

- Proven experience owning SEO accounts and deliverables from planning through execution.

- Experience with law firms or other highly competitive local service industries strongly preferred.

- Demonstrated experience with website migrations, consolidations, or large-scale URL restructuring.

- Strong WordPress proficiency and ability to make routine SEO changes without developer support.

- Working knowledge of HTML, schema markup, and structured data.

- Experience managing or developing at least one other contributor.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Highly organized, proactive, accountable, and comfortable managing multiple client priorities independently.

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.



Tools & Platforms:



Experience with:

- Semrush

- Ahrefs and/or Majestic

- Screaming Frog

- Google Search Console

- Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

- Google Tag Manager

- BrightLocal or comparable local SEO platforms

- WordPress



What Success Looks Like:

The successful SEO Manager consistently delivers contracted SEO work on schedule, independently manages day-to-day priorities, and identifies problems before they become missed deadlines. They demonstrate strong technical execution, improve organic and AI search visibility, successfully manage complex migrations and local SEO initiatives, and keep leadership informed of meaningful risks and opportunities.



Above all, this person takes ownership of SEO delivery—staying on top of accounts, priorities, and performance without needing to be repeatedly asked for updates.



Application Process

If you meet the requirements outlined above and are interested in this opportunity, please complete our quick application form by uploading your resume and submitting a short 1-minute introduction video.



In your video briefly share:

- Your professional background

- The types of work you specialize in

- Why this opportunity interests you



We will review applications and contact qualified candidates regarding next steps.

title: Google & Meta Ads Performance Specialist
description:
We are a growing digital marketing company serving businesses in the marine, RV, powersports, automotive, and related industries. We are looking for an experienced Google & Meta Ads Performance Specialist who can help us build, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns that generate qualified leads for our clients.



This is not simply an ad setup position.



We are looking for someone who understands strategy, targeting, retargeting, lead generation, conversion tracking, testing, and ongoing campaign optimization and can help us continuously improve client results.



What You Will Be Responsible For



Google Ads



* Build and launch Google Search campaigns

* Conduct keyword and competitor research

* Develop campaign and ad group structures

* Create keyword targeting strategies

* Manage negative keywords and search terms

* Write and test ad copy

* Set up location and geographic targeting

* Build remarketing/retargeting campaigns

* Optimize bidding, budgets, keywords, and conversions

* Improve cost per lead and lead quality over time



Meta Ads



* Build and manage
 and Instagram campaigns

* Develop prospecting and retargeting strategies

* Create and manage custom audiences and lookalike audiences

* Develop geographic and demographic targeting strategies

* Test audiences, creative, offers, and messaging

* Build retargeting campaigns for website visitors and engaged audiences

* Optimize campaigns toward qualified leads rather than simply clicks or impressions



Tracking & Measurement



* Set up and verify conversion tracking

* Work with Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics/GA4, Meta Pixel, and related tracking tools

* Track calls, forms, landing-page conversions, and other lead actions

* Identify tracking problems before they impact campaign decisions

* Provide clear reporting on campaign performance



90-Day Client Campaign Strategy



Many of our new clients begin with a 90-day campaign period.



You should understand that campaigns require ongoing optimization rather than simply launching ads and waiting for results.



We need someone who can think strategically across the entire 90 days:



Days 1–30: Setup, research, launch, data collection, tracking verification, and initial testing.



Days 31–60: Optimize targeting, search terms, audiences, creative, budgets, bids, landing pages, and retargeting based on actual campaign data.



Days 61–90: Improve lead quality and cost per lead, scale what is working, eliminate wasted spend, and develop recommendations for the client’s next stage of growth.



The goal is to continuously improve performance and generate qualified leads and real business opportunities for our clients.



Ongoing Client Management



This role will include both new and recurring clients.



For new clients, you may be responsible for:



* Account audits

* Campaign strategy

* Campaign setup

* Tracking setup

* Launch

* Initial optimization



For recurring clients, you will be responsible for:



* Weekly campaign monitoring

* Budget management

* Bid optimization

* Search-term analysis

* Audience optimization

* Retargeting

* Creative/ad testing

* Conversion optimization

* Identifying wasted spend

* Scaling successful campaigns

* Providing strategic recommendations



We want someone who proactively says:



“Here is what I’m seeing in the data, here is what I think is happening, and here is what I recommend we do next.”



What We’re Looking For



You should have strong hands-on experience with:



* Google Ads

* Meta Ads Manager

* Google Search campaigns

* Lead-generation campaigns

* Retargeting/remarketing

* Audience targeting

* Keyword research

* Conversion tracking

* Google Tag Manager

* Google Analytics / GA4

* Meta Pixel

* Campaign optimization

* A/B testing

* Budget management

* Cost-per-lead optimization

* Landing-page/conversion analysis

* Client reporting



Experience managing local or regional lead-generation campaigns is highly preferred.



Experience with dealerships, marine businesses, RV companies, powersports, automotive, home services, or other high-ticket businesses is a major plus.



The Most Important Part



We are not looking for someone whose primary experience is boosting posts, generating traffic, or reporting impressions.



Our clients care about:



Leads. Calls. Form submissions. Appointments. Sales opportunities. Revenue.



You should understand how advertising fits into the client’s overall customer acquisition strategy.



When Applying



Please answer the following questions:



1. How many years have you managed Google Ads?

2. How many years have you managed Meta Ads?

3. What types of lead-generation businesses have you worked with?

4. Give an example of a campaign where you improved cost per lead or lead volume. What did you change?

5. How do you approach the first 30 days of a new Google Ads campaign?

6. How do you build a retargeting strategy across Google and Meta?

7. How do you determine whether poor campaign performance is caused by the ads, targeting, offer, landing page, or tracking?

8. What conversion tracking tools are you comfortable setting up?

9. Approximately how many client accounts can you actively manage at once?

10. Please provide screenshots, case studies, or examples of previous campaign results if available.



IMPORTANT: Begin your application with the words “90 DAY PERFORMANCE” so we know you read the entire job description.



Opportunity

title: Senior Accountant
description:
TO APPLY PLEASE CLICK HERE: 



We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Accountant with robust US GAAP and controllership experience to anchor our accounting function during a pivotal period of growth and transformation.



Our current team handles day-to-day transactional processing and routine bookkeeping efficiently. However, as we advance through an active audit, a major software migration, and broader process improvement initiatives, we require a senior-level technical expert. Your primary focus will not be high-volume transactional work, but rather providing the deep accounting judgment, rigorous review capabilities, and control structures needed to ensure absolute technical accuracy and audit readiness.



You will partner directly with leadership to bridge the gap between day-to-day operations and high-level strategic financial oversight.



Key Responsibilities & Challenges to Solve:



*Technical GAAP & Specialized Accounting

- Fixed Assets & Capitalization: Oversee PPE accounting, refine and enforce capitalization policies, manage asset disposals, evaluate impairment considerations, and ensure the fixed asset register is flawlessly maintained.

- Technical GAAP Review: Act as the critical second line of defense. Review complex transactions, contract assessments, and financing arrangements, making definitive accounting treatment decisions before they become audit findings.



*Controllership, Month-End, & Oversight

- Month-End Close & Accruals: Partner with leadership to strengthen accrual methodologies, strictly enforce cut-off procedures, and significantly reduce the manual adjustments identified during close.

- Balance Sheet Reconciliations & Controls: Establish and enforce elevated reconciliation standards, design stronger review controls, and foster clear ownership across all key accounts.

- Audit Management & Documentation: Prepare detailed audit schedules, reports, and technical documentation for review by management and external auditors, ensuring full compliance with US GAAP standards.



*Process Improvement & System Transformation

- System Migration & Workflow Design: Active partner in our upcoming software migration. Document current processes, identify internal control gaps, redesign workflows, and ensure complex accounting requirements are accurately mapped into the new system.

- Fraud Prevention & Risk Mitigation: Continually assess financial risk, investigate discrepancies, and implement improvements to internal control systems to prevent errors and fraud.



Qualifications & Requirements:



- Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and required experience with QuickBooks Online. Experience with NetSuite is preferred, along with familiarity navigating complex accounting systems and software migrations

- Experience: Proven experience as a Senior Accountant, Financial Auditor, or Assistant Controller with deep, hands-on expertise in US GAAP and complex capitalization policies.

- Analytical Depth: Exceptional analytical skills with a proven ability to interpret complex financial data and apply high-level accounting judgment.

- Execution: Strong organizational skills with a meticulous attention to detail. Ability to work independently, manage shifting timelines, and thrive in a fully remote environment.

- Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of educating staff on policies and presenting clear findings to external auditors and leadership.

title: Motion Design Artist for Video Production Agency (Full-Time Only)
description:
We're looking for an Motion Design Artist with Strong Specialty in After Effects to join Jeong X. This is a hands-on After Effects + motion design role working alongside our team of editors — your job is to use your creativity to create visuals that tell the story and elevate the educational and narrative value of every video we produce. 



From Netflix-level documentaries to high-performing YouTube videos, you'll design and animate the graphics, motion, and new assets that turn a solid cut into a premium, polished piece. If you love the craft of designing and animating in AE — creating new assets from scratch, 3D camera work, compositing, and finishing — this role is built for you.



APPLY HERE: 



## What you'll build — a few examples



These aren't the whole job — they're a sense of the kinds of assets you'll create. Day to day, you'll use your own eye and creativity to design visuals that carry the story and make each video clearer and more engaging:



1. **Designed visual containers** — designing and building frames and containers in After Effects that hold lower-resolution or archival footage, so it sits cleanly in a Netflix-level piece. The footage should feel intentional and designed, never like a low-res clip dropped on screen.

2. **Animated maps** — one of the more complex and important builds. Designing and animating map sequences with 3D camera moves, detailed keyframing, and multi-layer compositions that guide the viewer through locations and journeys. Comfort designing in 3D space, camera animation, and layered comps in AE is essential.

3. **Tilt-shift & blur maps** — creating custom depth-of-field / tilt-shift and blur passes scene by scene. Each scene gets its own blur map, so this takes a careful, consistent eye and real patience for detail across many shots.



Beyond examples like these, you'll design and animate whatever a piece needs to tell its story well — titles, lower-thirds, transitions, custom graphic elements — always in service of the story and the viewer's understanding.



## What we're looking for (required)



- Deep After Effects skill with a real motion design sensibility — designing and animating new assets, 3D camera and keyframe animation, multi-layer compositions, compositing, and finishing.

- A storyteller's instinct — you use visuals to make ideas clearer and more engaging, elevating the educational and narrative value of a video rather than just decorating it.

- Direct experience animating maps or complex 3D-camera sequences in AE. Point us to examples in your reel.

- A premium, cinematic eye — you understand what makes motion design and footage read as "high-end" versus amateur.

- A good sense of sound design — you understand how sound and motion work together, and how audio lifts the quality of VFX and motion graphics. You won't be the sole audio person, but this sensibility matters.

- After Effects + motion design experience across both social / YouTube and long-form work (show us both).

- Precision and patience for repetitive, detail-critical work (like per-scene blur maps) without the quality slipping.

- Able to work remotely alongside an editor — take direction, turn notes around quickly, and hit deadlines.

- A portfolio or reel that demonstrates the above (link required).



## Nice to have



- 3D beyond AE — Cinema 4D, Blender, or Element 3D.

- Compositing depth: tracking, rotoscoping, keying, and cleanup.

- Strong design chops — comfortable creating assets in Photoshop and Illustrator.

- Sound design or audio editing experience.

- Familiarity with Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve for hand-off with our editor.

- Experience in a documentary, film, or long-form / YouTube environment.



## Tools you'll use



Adobe After Effects (primary — this is 90% of the role), plus Premiere Pro / Photoshop / Illustrator; 3D tools (Cinema 4D / Blender / Element 3D) a strong plus.

We're an established toys and games brand coming off one of the most successful sport-related backyard game products in the category — and we're just getting started. You'll organize and own the entire creator and affiliate strategy for a fast-growing sports and toys company with multiple hero SKUs and audiences.

We believe the days of sourcing content from a handful of creators who aren't bought into your mission or brand are behind us. The way to win today is to build an affiliate army — hundreds, if not thousands, of creators posting about our products every single day. That's the level we want to reach, and we have high conviction that our products are perfect for this model.

-Building the affiliate army in Trybe (our affiliate software platform) — growing it from 10, to 50, to 100, and eventually all the way to 1,000 active affiliates.

-Creator briefs and accountability — writing clear briefs and holding creators to a high bar for content quality and delivery.

-Content sourcing at scale — leading the charge on generating the most valuable asset any modern ecom brand has: content.

-Reporting — weekly updates to the founders and social team on program growth and content performance.



Why this is a rare opportunity:



-You bring the playbook. You're not being asked to follow our rules — we need you to fit seamlessly into the company and bring your own systems. You're the expert, and we'll build the role around you so the affiliate program can reach incredible levels with a reliable content generation engine behind it..

-Performance upside. Competitive base salary plus performance-based pay incentives tied to the growth targets above..

-Direct access to founders. Lean, global, AI-first team where speed wins — no layers between you and the people making decisions..

-Category timing. Physical games and backyard sports are having a generational moment. Content for our products is easy to produce and has extreme virality. You'll be judged on the performance of the content you source — and being positioned as the brand that generates FUN makes that easy for the right candidate..

-True remote flexibility. Work the hours you want, in the timezone that suits you. As long as the work gets done, we're happy..



Who we're looking for:

-You build your own systems. You design and implement processes without needing direction..

title: PPC Manager
description:
About Us

We’re a performance-driven digital marketing agency specializing in lead generation for real estate agents and brokerages across North America. We build and manage high-performing ad campaigns that drive measurable results for our clients, and we’re growing our team to keep raising the bar.



About the Role

As PPC Manager, you’ll be the senior paid search authority on the team — responsible for the overall health and performance of our client accounts, the quality of work produced by our PPC Specialists, and the technical standards that underpin everything we build and track. 



In addition to overseeing the team and portfolio, you'll personally manage a select group of our highest-value client accounts — hands-on, end to end. These are our largest budgets and most demanding clients, and they deserve our most senior expertise. 

You’re an experienced PPC professional who can zoom out to assess portfolio-level performance and zoom in to diagnose a broken conversion tag or untangle a complex account issue. You’re a builder and an operator: you set the standard, ensure the team meets it, and aren’t above getting your hands dirty when accounts need it.







Key Responsibilities

Account Oversight & Performance Management

Maintain a high-level view across all active client accounts, monitoring performance trends and ensuring accounts are hitting lead volume and cost-per-lead targets

Hold PPC Specialists accountable to campaign quality standards — reviewing work, identifying gaps, and stepping in to course-correct where needed

Conduct regular account audits to catch structural issues, budget inefficiencies, or performance drift before they escalate

Own the performance conversation: understand what’s working, what’s not, and what needs to change across the portfolio



Direct Management of Key Accounts

Personally own and manage a portfolio of high-spend, high-priority client accounts — strategy, optimization, testing, and performance are yours end to end

Apply advanced optimization and bidding strategies on these accounts, and use them as the proving ground for tactics that can be rolled out across the broader portfolio

Partner closely with Account Managers on these clients to ensure performance insights are communicated clearly and proactively

Treat these accounts as the standard-setters — the work here should model what "great" looks like for the rest of the team





Campaign Building

Build new paid search campaigns from scratch across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, including structure, targeting, bidding, and ad copy

Set the template and standard for how campaigns are built so Specialists can execute consistently and at scale

Ensure all campaigns — whether built by you or the team — are correctly structured for geographic targeting, ad relevance, keyword intent, and lead quality



Troubleshooting & Technical Escalations

Serve as the go-to resource for complex account issues that fall outside the Specialists’ scope — performance anomalies, tracking failures, platform errors, and edge cases

Diagnose and resolve conversion tracking issues using Google Tag Manager, GA4, and platform-native tools

Write and modify tracking code (JavaScript, HTML) as needed for tag implementation and troubleshooting — this is a hands-on requirement

Coordinate with developers or Account Managers when issues require cross-functional resolution



Quality Control & Standards

Define and maintain QA standards for campaign builds, tracking setups, and account management practices

Review Specialist work at key checkpoints — pre-launch, post-launch, and ongoing — to ensure quality and consistency

Identify recurring issues or gaps in execution and address them through training, process updates, or SOP refinement



Automation, AI & Efficiency

Build and manage Google Ads scripts and automation rules to streamline recurring tasks and improve efficiency across the portfolio

Actively use AI-powered tools in your workflow and encourage the team to do the same — for copy, analysis, troubleshooting, or process improvement

Identify opportunities to systematize or automate work and bring those improvements to the broader team



Process & Documentation

Own and evolve internal SOPs for campaign builds, QA, tracking, and account management so processes are scalable and not dependent on any one person

Document troubleshooting approaches, edge cases, and solutions so the team builds institutional knowledge over time

Stay ahead of platform updates and best practices — and translate what’s relevant into actionable guidance for the team



Requirements

Must-Have

5+ years of hands-on PPC campaign management in an agency environment, with a strong and demonstrable track record

Expert-level proficiency in Google Ads — you can build, audit, troubleshoot, and optimize accounts independently and set the standard for others

Solid experience with Microsoft Advertising and both Google Ads Editor and Microsoft Ads Editor

Deep, practical knowledge of Google Tag Manager and GA4 for conversion tracking setup, troubleshooting, and QA

Hands-on ability to read and write JavaScript and HTML for tag and tracking implementations — required, not optional

Demonstrated experience overseeing or reviewing the work of other PPC practitioners, whether formally or informally

Proven ability to troubleshoot complex account and tracking issues and see them through to resolution

Experience with Google Ads scripts or other automation tools

Working knowledge of AI tools applied to PPC workflows

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to hold a portfolio view across multiple clients without losing sight of the details

Located in the Greater Toronto Area or Hamilton region — remote role with occasional in-person team events



Nice-to-Have

Background in real estate, home services, or local lead generation

Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, or GA4 certifications

Experience building or owning agency SOPs and internal process documentation

Familiarity with Google Looker Studio for client reporting and dashboards



Tools & Platforms

You’ll work with these tools regularly — we’re looking for someone who already knows them well:

Google Ads & Google Ads Editor

Microsoft Advertising & Microsoft Ads Editor

Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

Google Tag Manager (GTM)

Google Looker Studio

AI and automation tools



What We’re Looking For

Beyond the technical qualifications, we want someone who:

Leads by example — you set a high standard for how accounts should be built and managed, and the team rises to meet it

Is the person others come to — when something breaks or doesn’t make sense, you’re the one people trust to figure it out

Thinks at both levels — you can assess portfolio health from 10,000 feet and debug a GTM container at ground level

Builds for scale — you don’t just solve problems, you document the fix and prevent the next one

Communicates clearly — you can explain complex issues in plain language to Account Managers and flag risks before they become client problems

Takes ownership — you treat the portfolio like it’s yours and hold yourself and others to a high bar



Daily Tasks

Account Health Monitoring

Scan for disapproved ads, policy violations, or platform alerts requiring same day attention

Check budget pacing across account and flag any that are significantly over/under pacing (if adjustments or comments have not been made)

Review daily spend on all accounts and ensure that accounts with no spend have been flagged/are being investigated. Accounts with no leads generated for 2+ days are flagged and being investigated



Specialist Oversight and Escalations

Be available as the first point of escalation for specialist questions or blockers

Review any urgent issues flagged by AMs and respond within 24 hours

Triage any tracking failures, conversion discrepancies, or performance anomalies reported by the team



Campaign Builds/Campaign QA

Review any new campaign builds submitted by the specialists against the QA checklist

Build new campaigns for onboarding clients, setting up structure, ad groups, keyword lists, conversion tracking, etc.

Directly Managed Accounts

Perform daily monitoring and optimizations on your directly managed accounts (bids, budgets, search terms, ad performance)

Ensure these accounts receive the same or higher standard of attention you expect from Specialists







Weekly Tasks

Account Health Monitoring

Ensure all accounts have received 2 weekly updates

Ensure that relevant adjustments are being made, and valuable insights being shared



Team Development

Conduct a weekly checkin meeting with each in-house PPC specialist, review workload, assess quality trends, and provide developmental feedback





Monthly Tasks

Account Health Monitoring

Assess the full account portfolio for month over month trends (lead volume, CPL, spend/pacing)

Identify account that are consistently underperforming and develop a structured improvement plan

Identify top performing accounts and document what's driving results so it can be applied elsewhere

title: Head of Social Strategy
description:
Head of Social Strategy (we’re hiring a real Head of Social, not a social media manager)

Remote | Full-time



Own the social strategy for exciting new launches in toys & games



We're an established toys and games brand, coming off the back of one of the most successful sport-related backyard game products in the category. We're now transitioning into a wider sports-related toys and games company, speed running zero to one million customers over the next three years.



We're assembling a team of highly talented people to own each department, and this role is one of them.



Our thesis: anyone can copy a product. Nobody can copy a fan base.



The great modern game brands aren't selling objects in boxes. They're building platforms, and social content is how they do it:



-Spikeball took a backyard game and turned it into a genuine sport: active players, in-person events, and a real community.

-Popdarts took a simple table game and now kids call themselves Popdarts players, build Instagram handles around it, and show up to live events. It's become a niche sport in its own right.

-Exploding Kittens built a cult following of fans who wait for every new game and drop. A franchise, not a one-off product.

-Golf Daddy and Bucket Golf haven't built community at that level, but they've built huge social followings around their product and their game, proof of how far pure content can carry a brand.



That spectrum — from big social following all the way to genuine sport with real-world events — is exactly the playbook we're running across our portfolio.



For each of our hero products, this role strategies and owns the build: where on that spectrum the brand should live, and how content, community, and drops get it there.



The Role



You are the strategist and owner of organic growth across the entire portfolio.



This is not a traditional social media manager role. You're not simply scheduling posts or managing an existing content calendar.



You'll design the strategies and be accountable for getting them shipped and hitting numbers, working through creators, clippers, editors, and affiliate armies.



You'll own things like:



-Building our flagship new launch into a platform brand. Target: 250K Instagram followers, with an audience hooked on updates and drops.

-A short-form machine across TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Target: 1 billion cumulative organic views portfolio-wide.

-The affiliate engine. This is central to how we'll grow. Traditional UGC and content sourcing is slow: one creator, one brief, one video at a time. Hudson Leogrande's brand Comfrt revolutionized it by building an army of affiliates on TikTok Shop, hundreds of core creators posting daily and thousands more on open enrollment, generating a torrent of content that then fuels Meta, Instagram, and AppLovin paid acquisition. That is the system we're building. Ideally you've worked with this model before; if not, you'll work with the team and founders on running it.

-Turning a product into a sport. Building a fan base and community from zero, with a roadmap to real-world events and competition.

-Creative that stands out. Coming up with ideas and running shoots that make our brands impossible to scroll past. We're always generating content that stands out, not doing the same as every other brand on Instagram.

-Monthly reporting to the founders. Growth, views, affiliate revenue, community, learnings, and next moves.



Why This Is a Rare Opportunity



-Whole-portfolio ownership from day one. You're not inheriting someone else's playbook or optimizing a mature account. You're writing the strategy for multiple new category launches, with the founders as your only stakeholders.

-Proven engine behind you. This isn't zero-to-one on a maybe. The existing brand does eight figures, paid acquisition is firing, and the products are already built. But great paid acquisition runs on a constant supply of high-level content, and generating that is exactly what this role owns. The organic flywheel is the missing piece, and the moat.

-Category timing. Physical games and backyard sports are having a generational moment, and short-form is how they blow up. The right operator here gets to put their name on category-defining launches.

-Lean, global, AI-first team where speed wins, shipping beats meetings, and you have direct access to both founders.



Who We're Looking For



-You've personally grown a brand or creator account to six-figures+ followers and can show us the account and the numbers.

-You've built or run an affiliate, clipper, or TikTok Shop creator program with revenue attached. Direct experience with the -Comfrt-style affiliate model is a major advantage; at minimum you need a genuine understanding of how it works and why it wins.

-You're incredibly creative and think outside the box: you generate original content ideas and can plan and run shoots, not just repost what every other brand is doing.

-You're platform-native: you know what's working on TikTok and Reels this month, not last year.

-You understand fandom: drops, scarcity, community, events. Games, sports, or toys experience is a big plus.

-You build systems, not one-offs: playbooks, trackers, repeatable machines.

-You move fast and use AI tools aggressively to multiply your output.



How to apply



Skip the cover letter. Send us:



1. Links to accounts or programs you've grown, with numbers

2. A one-page take: how would you take a brand-new game brand from 0 to its first 50K followers?



We're interested in your actual thinking and strategy — including your content approach, creator/affiliate strategy, community-building ideas, and how you would measure success.



Applications that do not include both requirements above may not be considered. Thank you

title: AI-Assisted Software Developer
description:
ABOUT SHOP MARKETING PROS:

We are a marketing agency based in the United States with a stateside and international team of 50 professionals. Shop Marketing Pros is a very well-respected and rapidly growing Digital Marketing Company in the Automotive Repair Industry with strong core values and a superb track record of serving its clients better than competitors. Our key services include customized Website Design, Digital Advertising, Search Engine Optimization, and Social Media Management. 



We are now investing heavily in proprietary software. We are building internal and client-facing

platforms that will improve our agency’s operations, help clients understand their marketing

results, and create new capabilities for the future.



Our Core Values are of incredible importance to us. We live by our “SHIELD” so please visit 
/core-values/ and familiarize yourself with our Core Values before continuing. Please continue with this job description and application if you feel you align with these values.





COMPANY BENEFITS + PERKS:

1) This is a full-time, permanent, remote position from Monday to Friday, 8 am to 4 pm Central Time.

2) 13th Month Pay

3) Unlimited PTO (after 3 months of employment)

JOB DESCRIPTION:

You will help design, build, and maintain proprietary software—including marketing attribution platforms, reporting dashboards, internal business systems, WordPress plugins, automations, and third-party integrations—that improve our operations and deliver greater value to our clients.

Success in this role requires a strong understanding of software development fundamentals and the ability to use AI coding tools effectively to plan, build, test, troubleshoot, and improve software. Supabase and PostgreSQL

Vercel

WordPress and PHP

n8n, Zapier, or Make

Digital marketing platforms, reporting systems, attribution software, or agency operations

Experience with comparable technologies is acceptable if you have strong fundamentals and

can learn our stack quickly.





JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Translate business requirements into well-defined technical implementation tasks.

title: Creative Strategist / Senior Ad Editor – Dropshipping & Meta Ads About the Role
description:
We are building a performance-focused dropshipping operation across multiple international markets and are looking for an experienced Creative Strategist / Senior Ad Editor to help us build our creative department.



This is NOT a traditional branding position.



Our business is built around fast product testing, competitor research, high-quality creative execution and systematic scaling of winning products.



Creative output is one of the most important parts of our entire operation. We are therefore looking for someone who understands both sides:



Strategy + Execution.



You should understand how to find winning concepts, turn them into structured tests, create clear Creative Briefs and work hands-on with editors to produce high-quality ads.



Initially, this position will start on a smaller scale as a test phase. If the collaboration and results are strong, the goal is to develop this into a long-term Creative Team Lead position and build the creative team together.



How Our Creative Testing Works



Understanding our process is important.



Stage 1: Product Testing



When testing a new product, we start with proven competitor ads.



These creatives need to be recreated and localized at a very high standard.



We care about:



Accurate localization and translation

High-quality video and image execution

Matching the original creative structure

Matching the pacing, voiceover and overall feel of the reference

Correct product, offer and funnel information

Clean and professional execution



The goal is not to unnecessarily reinvent a proven concept during the initial test.



The goal is to create a high-quality version of an already validated creative so we can properly test the product and offer.



Stage 2: Scaling Winning Products



Once a product passes our initial testing phase, creative strategy becomes much more important.



You will:



Find additional competitor ads and concepts

Research competitors continuously

Identify new hooks and angles

Analyze existing winning ads

Create iterations of winning creatives

Build structured A/B tests

Write Creative Briefs for editors

Coordinate production of new ads



We don't want random creative variations.



Every new creative should have a reason for being tested and, where possible, isolate variables so we can understand what actually improved or hurt performance.



Stage 3: Expanding Beyond Competitor Ads



Eventually, competitor creatives alone are not enough.



At this stage, you should be able to expand the creative library through:



Reinterpreting winning ads from other products or markets

Taking proven creative structures and applying a different angle

Developing new concepts from scratch

Using current market and advertising trends

Following our internal SOPs and frameworks

Creating new hooks, angles and formats based on actual performance data



The objective is to continuously increase creative output without simply producing more of the same.



Awareness & Funnel Understanding



You should understand that not every customer needs to see the same message.



Experience with concepts such as:



Customer Awareness Stages

Top of Funnel (TOF)

Middle of Funnel (MOF)

Bottom of Funnel (BOF)

Problem-aware vs. solution-aware audiences

Different hooks and angles for different levels of awareness



is important.



When developing new concepts, we want our creative library to cover different awareness stages instead of targeting every customer with the same message.



Your Responsibilities

Creative Research & Strategy

Research competitors and their advertising

Find strong reference ads for new product tests

Identify winning hooks, angles and creative structures

Monitor creative trends in the market

Analyze existing winners and develop new iterations

Create structured Creative Briefs

Plan A/B tests and creative variations

Develop concepts from scratch when competitor material becomes limited

Creative Production



You must also be comfortable working hands-on.



You should be able to:



Recreate competitor creatives at a high standard

Produce Meta video and image ads

Edit voiceovers, subtitles, visuals and pacing

Work with UGC and existing media

Create AI-generated assets when required

Turn Creative Briefs into finished ads

Quality Control



A major part of this position is ensuring that our creative output maintains a consistently high standard.



You will review creatives for:



Translation and localization quality

Visual accuracy

Voiceover quality

Pacing and editing

Correct offers and product information

Consistency with the reference or Creative Brief

Overall readiness before creatives go live

Building the Creative Team



This role starts hands-on.



We are NOT looking for someone who only wants to manage other people.



However, our long-term goal is to build a dedicated creative team around this position.



If the test phase is successful, you will have the opportunity to become our Creative Team Lead.



Together, we will:



Hire additional editors

Build efficient workflows

Create and improve SOPs

Assign Creative Briefs

Review editor output

Maintain quality standards

Increase daily creative output

Develop a scalable creative production system across different markets



If you already know talented editors or other potential creative team members you have successfully worked with before, that is a strong plus.



Experience We're Looking For



Ideally, you already have experience with:



Dropshipping

Meta /
 Ads

Performance creative production

Creative strategy

Competitor ad research

Creative Brief creation

Direct-response advertising

Creative testing and A/B testing

Awareness stages and funnel concepts

Scaling winning products through additional creatives



Previous experience working inside a high-volume dropshipping operation or performance marketing team is a major advantage.



Tools



You should be comfortable with modern creative production tools such as:



CapCut

Adobe Premiere Pro / Photoshop or similar

ElevenLabs

Higgsfield

Magnific

Freepik

AI image and video generation tools



You don't need to know every tool we use from day one.



More important is that you understand how to use modern AI and editing tools to achieve high-quality output quickly and efficiently.



Who We're Looking For



You should be someone who:



Understands the dropshipping testing and scaling environment

Thinks strategically but is still willing to execute

Has a strong eye for performance creatives

Can distinguish between copying a winner and strategically iterating a winner

Understands Creative Briefs

Understands A/B testing

Can work quickly without sacrificing quality

Is highly organized and reliable

Takes ownership

Communicates clearly in English

Can eventually coordinate and lead other editors



We care less about cinematic editing and more about your ability to create high-quality ads that are built to convert.



Long-Term Opportunity



We are starting this position at a smaller scale to test the collaboration, workflow and results.



If it works, this is intended to become a long-term position with significantly more responsibility.



Our goal is to build a creative department capable of supporting multiple products and markets with a consistently high creative output.



For the right person, this means the opportunity to grow from a hands-on Creative Strategist into the person responsible for creative strategy, production and eventually the creative team itself.



How to Apply



Please send:



Examples of Meta ads you have created

Examples of dropshipping products or campaigns you have worked on

At least one Creative Brief you have written, if available

The tools you currently use

A short explanation of how you research competitor ads

A short explanation of how you would create new creatives after the available competitor ads have been exhausted

Explain how you would use different awareness stages when creating ads for the same product

Tell us whether you have previously managed editors or have editors you have successfully worked with before



Please do not send only a general video editing portfolio.



We want to see that you understand the complete process:



Research ? Competitor Ads ? Testing ? Analysis ? Iteration ? Creative Briefs ? Scaling.

title: AI-Enabled Ecommerce Operations Assistant
description:

One company is an established ecommerce business selling high-end shower fixtures and products from premium manufacturers. The second is a U.S. manufacturer of unique copper shower systems that is rapidly expanding its products, marketing, ecommerce presence, and internal operations.



This is NOT a customer service, sales, cold-calling, or appointment-setting position.



This is a hands-on EXECUTION role.



We have more valuable projects and growth opportunities than our small team currently has time to complete. We need someone who enjoys taking a project, researching what they don't know, using AI and technology intelligently, organizing the information, and getting the work DONE.



Your work will include a variety of projects such as:



• Shopify product creation and product-page management

• Adding and researching new products and manufacturers

• SEO, keyword research, AEO, and website optimization

• AI-assisted content creation and editing

• Canva and social media content

• Product and competitor research

• Vendor and manufacturer research

• Spreadsheet and data organization

• Basic bookkeeping/accounting preparation

• Organizing receipts, invoices, and business records

• Creating and organizing SOPs and internal documentation

• Turning recordings and transcripts into professional procedures and guides

• Organizing installation guides and technical information

• General ecommerce and business operations projects



AI is a MAJOR part of how we operate.



We actively use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Canva AI, and other technology to allow a small team to accomplish much more. We are especially interested in someone who already uses AI creatively for research, ecommerce, content, spreadsheets, organization, documentation, and repetitive workflows.



You do NOT need to be an expert in everything listed above.



We would much rather hire someone who is intelligent, extremely detail-oriented, dependable, curious, and excellent at figuring things out.



Experience with Shopify, ecommerce, ChatGPT/Claude, Canva, Google Sheets/Excel, SEO, product listings, and online research is strongly preferred.



Experience with QuickBooks, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, WordPress, Ahrefs/Semrush, Zapier/Make, Loom, Scribe, or basic HTML is a bonus.



This is intended to become a LONG-TERM position.



We are looking for one exceptional person who wants to learn our businesses, take increasing ownership of projects, and grow with us over time.



The position will begin at approximately 20–30 hours per week with the opportunity for increased hours, compensation, and responsibility for the right person.



The schedule can be largely flexible/asynchronous. You do not need to work overnight Philippine hours simply to match U.S. business hours.



We care about quality, reliability, communication, attention to detail, and completed results — not whether you are sitting at your computer during a particular U.S. time zone.

HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send us a generic cover letter. We are looking for someone who carefully reads instructions and is genuinely interested in this position.



Start your application with the words:



COPPER + CLOUD



Then answer the following questions:



1. Tell us briefly about yourself and your most relevant experience.



2. Shopify: What have you personally done inside Shopify? Please be specific rather than simply saying “Shopify management.”



3. AI: Give us 2 real examples of how you have used ChatGPT, Claude, or another AI tool to complete work faster or better. Tell us what the task was, how you used AI, and what the result was.



4. Research: Imagine we want to find a new premium shower or plumbing manufacturer whose products we could add to our ecommerce website. In 5 bullet points, explain how you would research and evaluate potential manufacturers.



5. Organization: Give us one example of a project where you were given messy or incomplete information and had to turn it into something organized and useful.



6. Please provide:



Your desired hourly rate in USD

Your current weekly availability

Whether you currently work for other clients

Your experience with Shopify, SEO, Canva, QuickBooks, and Google Sheets/Excel

Links to any relevant examples of your work, if available



7. AI HONESTY QUESTION: Did you use AI to help prepare this application? If yes, tell us how you used it.



Using AI will NOT disqualify you. In fact, we encourage intelligent AI use. We simply value honesty and want to understand how you work.



FINAL QUESTION: After reading this job posting, what is one thing about this role or our businesses that you would be excited to learn more about — and why?



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a small PAID skills assessment using realistic ecommerce and operations tasks.



We are looking for a long-term team member, and we look forward to hearing from you!

title: Executive Assistant to Founder (US Company) — Full-time, Remote
description:
About Us



We're a US-based strategy consultancy. We work with companies on positioning and market strategy, and we also run a paid membership community for professionals in our field. Both are extensions of our founder, which means this role sits close to the center of how the business actually runs, not on its periphery.



A note on discretion: we've kept our company and founder details out of this post on purpose. Our founder has a public profile, and we'd rather run a quiet search than a public one. We'll share who we are in full at the interview stage, and you'll be talking to real people on video well before any commitment is asked of you. Discretion is a core part of this job, so we're starting as we mean to go on.



The Role



We're hiring a strategic partner and right hand to the founder: someone who becomes an extension of how they think, operate, and show up in the world. This isn't a role defined by a fixed task list. It's defined by a standing relationship. You'll be trusted with the judgment calls, instructions, the things that need to happen without being asked twice, ensuring nothing slips through the cracks, and the follow-through that makes their time and attention go further.



Concretely, that means you'll move fluidly across four kinds of responsibility: protecting their time and attention, running the operational backbone of the business, representing their voice externally, and acting as an early-warning system for anything that needs their judgment before it becomes a problem.



The specific tasks will shift week to week. What won't shift is the level of trust, ownership, and proximity to the founder that the role carries.



The Kinds of Responsibility You'll Carry



- Guardian of their time and focus. You'll own the calendar and inbox not as scheduling mechanics, but as an exercise in judgment: knowing what deserves their attention, what can be handled without them, and what needs to be reframed before it reaches them.

- Operator of the business backbone. Payroll, compliance, contracts, vendor relationships, insurance, and account access all run through you. You're the person who makes sure the business doesn't trip over its own administration.

- Extension of their voice. You'll draft and send communications under their name, coordinate their public presence (content, speaking engagements, newsletter), and represent them accurately and well when they're not in the room.

- Partner in the community they've built. Supporting the parts of the membership community that depend on their personal relationships: speaker relationships and high-value member and prospect conversations.

- Trusted with the personal alongside the professional. A limited but real slice of the role touches personal logistics, in coordination with existing household support.



This is deliberately broad. The person who thrives here won't be looking for a checklist. They'll be looking for a role that grows in scope as trust builds, the same way it did for the person who held this seat before you.



You Might Be a Fit If You...



- Have been the right hand to a founder or executive before, and know that the job is really about judgment, not just execution.

- Can hold financial, legal, and personal responsibility (payroll, compliance, account access) with real accuracy and discretion.

- Write well enough that people can't tell where your draft ends and the founder's voice begins.

- Like building the systems and documentation that make a business less dependent on any one person's memory, including your own.

- Want a role that expands with you, not one that stays the same size for three years.



Required



- 3+ years in a senior Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff, or Operations Manager role supporting a founder or executive. Not general VA work.

- Demonstrated ownership of process-heavy administrative work (e.g., payroll, compliance, or similar systems) with high accuracy.

- Strong written English. You'll be drafting and sending communications under someone else's name and voice.

- Track record of managing multiple concurrent workstreams independently with minimal supervision.

- Discretion with sensitive financial, legal, and personal information.

- Stable internet and a reliable computer.



Strongly Preferred



- Experience with Gusto or a comparable payroll/HR platform, including US multi-state compliance.

- Comfort with content and media tools (Notion, Slack, basic video and social scheduling tools).

- Experience supporting a public-facing founder, creator, or executive with an active media presence.

- Familiarity with vendor and event logistics.



This role is not for



- Anyone currently holding another full-time job. This is a full-time seat.

- Agencies or teams applying on behalf of staff. We're hiring one person.



Working Style



- Highly organized and process-oriented. Able to build and document systems, not just execute tasks.

- Responsive and available for time-sensitive requests, including some evening and weekend flexibility around events and travel.

- Trustworthy with financial and legal responsibility, and comfortable being the last check before something goes out.



Our Hiring Process



1. Written application (below)

2. Preliminary video interview

3. Final video call with the founder

4. Offer, followed by a full handover period with the current EA before he leaves



How to Apply

Send all four of the items below. Applications missing any part won't be reviewed.



1. Start your message with the word PARTNER so we know you read this post properly.

2. Your resume.

3. A short note (200 to 400 words) on a time you operated as someone's right hand: a system, relationship, or judgment call you owned end to end, and how you made it work. Write it yourself, in your own words. We're reading for how you think and how you write, not for polish.

4. A video of yourself, 2 minutes maximum, answering: why this role, and what part of it are you least experienced in? Please don't script or edit it. We'd rather see you talk normally than watch a rehearsed pitch. A phone camera is completely fine.



We review applications as they come in and will reply to everyone who follows the instructions above.
